question: A company is expanding globally and needs to back up data on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to a different AWS Region. Most of the EBS volumes that store the data are encrypted, but some of the EBS volumes are unencrypted. The company needs the backup data from all the EBS volumes to be encrypted.  Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST management overhead?
A: Configure a lifecycle policy in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to create the EBS volume snapshots with cross-Region backups enabled. Encrypt the snapshot copies by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
B: Create a point-in-time snapshot of the EBS volumes. When the snapshot status is COMPLETED, copy the snapshots to another Region and set the Encrypted parameter to False.
C: Create a point-in-time snapshot of the EBS volumes. Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that uses server-side encryption. Turn on S3 Cross-Region Replication on the S3 bucket.
D: Schedule an AWS Lambda function with the Python runtime. Configure the Lambda function to create the EBS volume snapshots, encrypt the unencrypted snapshots, and copy the snapshots to another Region.
question_zh: 一家公司正在全球扩展，并且需要将 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上的数据备份到不同的 AWS Region。大部分存储数据的 EBS 卷是加密的，但一些 EBS 卷是未加密的。该公司需要所有 EBS 卷的备份数据都被加密。哪种解决方案可以以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

在 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 中配置生命周期策略，以创建启用跨区域备份的 EBS 卷快照。  
通过使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 对快照副本进行加密。
B_zh: 创建一个点-in-时间快照的 EBS 卷。 当快照状态是 COMPLETED，复制快照到另一个 Region 并设置 Encrypted 参数为 False。
C_zh: 创建一个点-in-时间快照的 EBS 卷。将快照复制到一个使用 server-side encryption 的 Amazon S3 桶。开启 S3 Cross-Region Replication 在 S3 桶上。
D_zh: 安排一个具有 Python 运行时的 AWS Lambda function。配置该 Lambda function 以创建 EBS volume 的快照，给未加密的快照进行加密，并将快照复制到另一个 Region。

Which of the following must be configured on the SysOps administrator's machine so that kubectl can communicate with the cluster API server?
A: The kubeconfig file
B: The kube-proxy Amazon EKS add-on
C: The Fargate profile
D: The eks-connector.yaml file
question_zh:

question: A company wants to collect data from an application to use for analytics. For the first 90 days, the data will be infrequently accessed but must remain highly available. A: Store the data in S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) for the first 90 days. Set up an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 90 days.
B: Store the data in S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) for the first 90 days. Set up an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 90 days.
C: Store the data in S3 Standard for the first 90 days. Set up an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 90 days.
D: Store the data in S3 Standard for the first 90 days. Set up an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 90 days.

question: A company is deploying a third-party unit testing solution that is delivered as an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI). All system configuration data is stored in Amazon DynamoDB. A SysOps administrator must implement a highly available solution that provides this functionality.  Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

B: Define an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group by using a launch template. Use the provided AMI in the launch template. Configure three On-Demand Instances and three Spot instances. Configure a maximum Spot Instance price in the launch template.
C: Define two Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups by using launch configurations. Use the provided AMI in the launch configurations. Configure three On-Demand Instances for one Auto Scaling group. Configure three Spot Instances for the other Auto Scaling group. Configure a maximum Spot Instance price in the launch configuration for the Auto Scaling group that has Spot Instances.
D: Define two Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups by using launch templates. Use the provides AMI in the launch templates. Configure three On-Demand Instances for one Auto Scaling group. Configure three Spot Instances for the other Auto Scaling group. Configure a maximum Spot Instance price in the launch template for the Auto Scaling group that has Spot Instances.
question_zh: 一家公司正在部署一个第三方单元测试解决方案，该解决方案作为 Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 提供。所有系统配置数据都存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。测试结果存储在 Amazon S3 中。 至少需要三个 EC2 实例来操作该产品。 公司的测试团队希望在 Spot Instance 价格达到某个阈值时使用另外三个 EC2 实例。 一个 SysOps 管理员必须实现一个提供此功能的高可用性解决方案。 哪个解决方案将以最少的操作开销满足这些要求？

B_zh: 通过使用启动模板定义一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组。使用启动模板中提供的 AMI。配置三个 On-Demand 实例和三个 Spot 实例。在启动模板中配置最大 Spot 实例价格。

question: A SysOps administrator creates an AWS CloudFormation template to define an application stack that can be deployed in multiple AWS Regions. How can the SysOps administrator automate the creation of the CloudWatch dashboard each time the application is deployed?

question: A company runs a website from Sydney, Australia. Users in the United States (US) and Europe are reporting that images and videos are taking a long time to load. B: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration.

question: A SysOps administrator wants to monitor the free disk space that is available on a set of Amazon EC2 instances that have Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes attached. The SysOps administrator wants to receive a notification when the used disk space of the EBS volumes exceeds a threshold value, but only when the DiskReadOps metric also exceeds a threshold value. The SysOps administrator has set up an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.  How can the SysOps administrator receive notification only when both metrics exceed their threshold values?
A: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances. Create a metric alarm for the disk space and a metric alarm for the DiskReadOps metric. Create a composite alarm that includes the two metric alarms to publish a notification to the SNS topic.
B: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances. Create a metric alarm for the disk space and a metric alarm for the DiskReadOps metric. Configure each alarm to publish a notification to the SNS topic.
C: Create a metric alarm for the EBSByteBalance% metric and a metric alarm for the DiskReadOps metric. Create a composite alarm that includes the two metric alarms to publish a notification to the SNS topic.
D: Configure detailed monitoring for the EC2 instances. Create a metric alarm for the disk space and a metric alarm for the DiskReadOps metric. Create a composite alarm that includes the two metric alarms to publish a notification to the SNS topic.

The SysOps administrator wants to receive a notification when the used disk space of the EBS volumes exceeds a threshold value, but only when the DiskReadOps metric also exceeds a threshold value.  
SysOps 管理员已经设置了一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。

创建一个复合警报，包含这两个指标警报，以向 SNS 主题发布通知。

question: A company's SysOps administrator needs to change the AWS Support plan for one of the company's AWS accounts. The account has multi-factor authentication (MFA) activated, and the MFA device is lost.  What should the SysOps administrator do to sign in?

question: A SysOps administrator needs to delete an AWS CloudFormation stack that is no longer in use. The CloudFormation stack is in the DELETE_FAILED state. The SysOps administrator has validated the permissions that are required to delete the CloudFormation stack.  Which of the following are possible causes of the DELETE_FAILED state? (Choose two.)
A: The configured timeout to delete the stack was too low for the delete operation to complete.
B: The stack contains nested stacks that must be manually deleted first.
C: The stack was deployed with the --disable-rollback option.
D: There are additional resources associated with a security group in the stack.
E: There are Amazon S3 buckets that still contain objects in the stack.
question_zh: 一名 SysOps 管理员需要删除一个不再使用的 AWS CloudFormation stack。 这 个 CloudFormation stack 处于 DELETE_FAILED 状态。 这 名 SysOps 管理员已经验证了删除 CloudFormation stack 所需的权限。 哪些可能是 DELETE_FAILED 状态的原因？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 配置的超时设置删除堆栈的时间太短，导致删除操作无法完成。
B_zh: 这个堆栈包含必须首先手动删除的嵌套堆栈。
C_zh: 这个堆栈被部署使用了 --disable-rollback 选项。
D_zh: 堆栈中与 security group 相关联的额外资源。
E_zh: 有 Amazon S3 桶仍然包含在堆栈中的对象。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员 需要 删除 一个 不再 使用 的 AWS CloudFormation stack。

question: A SysOps administrator needs to configure a solution that will deliver digital content to a set of authorized users through Amazon CloudFront. Unauthorized users must be restricted from access.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Store the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that does not have public access blocked. Use signed URLs to access the S3 bucket through CloudFront.
B: Store the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that has public access blocked. Use an origin access identity (OAI) to deliver the content through CloudFront. Restrict S3 bucket access with signed URLs in CloudFront.
C: Store the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that has public access blocked. Use an origin access identity (OAI) to deliver the content through CloudFront. Enable field-level encryption.
D: Store the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that does not have public access blocked. Use signed cookies for restricted delivery of the content through CloudFront.
question_zh: 一名 SysOps 管理员 需要  配置  一个  解决方案  ，  该  解决方案  将  通过  Amazon CloudFront  向  一组  授权  用户  传递  数字内容  。  未经授权  的  用户  必须  被  限制  访问  。  哪个  解决方案  将  满足  这些  要求 ？
A_zh: 将数字内容存储在一个没有阻止公共访问的 Amazon S3 bucket 中。使用签名的 URL 通过 CloudFront 访问 S3 bucket。

将数字内容存储在具有公共访问被阻止的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

D_zh: 将数字内容存储在一个没有阻止公共访问的 Amazon S3 bucket 中。使用签名的 cookies 通过 CloudFront 进行受限制的内容传递。

question: A SysOps administrator must ensure that a company's Amazon EC2 instances auto scale as expected. The SysOps administrator configures an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hook to send an event to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events), which then invokes an AWS Lambda function to configure the EC2 instances. When the configuration is complete, the Lambda function calls the complete-lifecycle-action event to put the EC2 instances into service. In testing, the SysOps administrator discovers that the Lambda function is not invoked when the EC2 instances auto scale.  What should the SysOps administrator do to resolve this issue?
A: Add a permission to the Lambda function so that it can be invoked by the EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) rule.
B: Change the lifecycle hook action to CONTINUE if the lifecycle hook experiences a failure or timeout.
C: Configure a retry policy in the EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) rule to retry the Lambda function invocation upon failure.
D: Update the Lambda function execution role so that it has permission to call the complete-lifecycle-action event.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员必须确保一家公司 的 Amazon EC2 实例 自动扩展 如预期那样。  
The SysOps administrator 配置 一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 生命周期钩子 以 发送 一个 事件 到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)， 这 然后 调用 一个 AWS Lambda 函数 来 配置 EC2 实例。  
When 配置 完成， Lambda 函数 调用 complete-lifecycle-action 事件 以 将 EC2 实例 置入 服务。  
在 测试 中， SysOps 管理员 发现 Lambda 函数 在 EC2 实例 自动扩展 时 没有 被 调用。  
What 应该 让 SysOps 管理员 做 以 解决 这个 问题？
A_zh: 添加一个权限到 Lambda 函数，以便它可以被 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 规则调用。
B_zh: 如果生命周期钩子经历失败或超时，将生命周期钩子动作更改为 CONTINUE。
C_zh: 在 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 规则中配置重试策略，以在失败时重试 Lambda 函数调用。
D_zh: 更新 Lambda 函数执行角色，以便它具有调用 complete-lifecycle-action 事件的权限。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员必须确保一家公司 的 Amazon EC2 实例 自动扩展 如预期那样。

question: A company has mandated the use of multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all IAM users, and requires users to make all API calls using the CLI. However, users are not prompted to enter MFA tokens, and are able to run CLI commands without MFA. In an attempt to enforce MFA, the company attached an IAM policy to all users that denies API calls that have not been authenticated with MFA.  What additional step must be taken to ensure that API calls are authenticated using MFA?
A: Enable MFA on IAM roles, and require IAM users to use role credentials to sign API calls.
B: Ask the IAM users to log into the AWS Management Console with MFA before making API calls using the CLI.
C: Restrict the IAM users to use of the console, as MFA is not supported for CLI use.
D: Require users to use temporary credentials from the get-session token command to sign API calls.
question_zh: 一家公司已规定所有 IAM 用户必须使用 multi-factor authentication (MFA)，并且要求用户使用 CLI 进行所有 API 调用，然而，用户不会被提示输入 MFA 令牌，并且能够在没有 MFA 的情况下运行 CLI 命令，试图强制执行 MFA 时，公司将一项 IAM 政策附加到所有用户，拒绝未经过 MFA 认证的 API 调用，什么额外的步骤必须采取以确保 API 调用使用 MFA 进行认证？
A_zh: 在 IAM 角色上启用 MFA，且要求 IAM 用户使用角色凭证来签署 API 调用。
B_zh: 让 IAM 用户在使用 CLI 进行 API 调用之前，登录到 AWS Management Console 并启用 MFA。
C_zh: 限制 IAM 用户使用控制台，因 MFA 不支持 CLI 使用。
D_zh: 要求 用户 使用 临时 凭证 从 get-session token 命令 来 签署 API 调用。

question: A SysOps administrator has blocked public access to all company Amazon S3 buckets. The SysOps administrator wants to be notified when an S3 bucket becomes publicly readable in the future.  What is the MOST operationally efficient way to meet this requirement?
A: Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically checks the public access settings for each S3 bucket. Set up Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send notifications.
B: Create a cron script that uses the S3 API to check the public access settings for each S3 bucket. Set up Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send notifications.
C: Enable S3 Event Notifications for each S3 bucket. Subscribe S3 Event Notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

什么是满足此要求的**最**操作上高效的方法？

创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数定期检查每个 S3 桶的公共访问设置。  
设置 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 以发送通知。
B_zh: 创建一个 cron 脚本，使用 S3 API 来检查每个 S3 bucket 的公共访问设置。设置 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 以发送通知。
C_zh: 为每个 S3 bucket 启用 S3 Event Notifications。订阅 S3 Event Notifications 到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。
D_zh: 在 AWS Config 中启用 s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited 管理规则。订阅 AWS Config 规则到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。

question: A company plans to launch a static website on its domain example.com and subdomain www.example.com using Amazon S3.  How should the SysOps administrator meet this requirement?

B: Create one S3 bucket with a wildcard named *.example.com for both the domain and subdomain.
C: Create two S3 buckets named example.com and www.example.com. Configure the subdomain bucket to redirect requests to the domain bucket.
D: Create two S3 buckets named http://example.com and http://*.example.com. Configure the wildcard (*) bucket to redirect requests to the domain bucket.

D_zh: 创建两个 S3 桶，命名为 http://example.com 和 http://*.example.com。配置通配符（*）桶，将请求重定向到域名桶。

一家公司计划将其多个高性能计算（HPC）虚拟机（VMs）迁移到 AWS 上的 Amazon EC2 实例。  
一个 SysOps 管理员必须为此部署识别一个 placement group。  
这个策略必须最小化网络延迟并且必须最大化 HPC VMs 之间的网络吞吐量。  
SysOps 管理员应选择哪种策略以满足这些要求？

question: An errant process is known to use an entire processor and run at 100%. A SysOps administrator wants to automate restarting an Amazon EC2 instance when the problem occurs for more than 2 minutes.  How can this be accomplished?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the EC2 instance with basic monitoring. Add an action to restart the instance.
B: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the EC2 instance with detailed monitoring. Add an action to restart the instance.
C: Create an AWS Lambda function to restart the EC2 instance, invoked on a scheduled basis every 2 minutes.
D: Create an AWS Lambda function to restart the EC2 instance, invoked by EC2 health checks.
question_zh:
一个异常的进程被知道使用整个处理器并且运行在100%。  
一个 SysOps 管理员想要自动重启当问题发生超过2分钟时的 Amazon EC2 实例。  
这如何可以实现？
A_zh: 为 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，具有基本监控。 添加一个操作以重启实例。
B_zh: 为 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，具有详细监控。 添加一个动作以重启实例。
C_zh: 创建 一个 AWS Lambda 函数 以 重启 EC2 实例 ， 被 调用 在 一个 定期 的 基础 上 每 2 分钟 。
D_zh: 创建 一个 AWS Lambda 函数 以 重启 EC2 实例 ，由 EC2 健康检查 调用。
question_zh_zh:
一个异常的进程被知道使用整个处理器并且运行在100%。  
An abnormal process is known to use the entire processor and run at 100%.  
一个 SysOps 管理员想要自动重启当问题发生超过2分钟时的 Amazon EC2 实例。  
A SysOps administrator wants to automatically restart Amazon EC2 instances when the problem persists for more than 2 minutes.  
这如何可以实现？  
How can this be achieved?

question: A company maintains a large set of sensitive data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company's security team asks a SysOps administrator to help verify that all current objects in the S3 bucket are encrypted.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create a script that runs against the S3 bucket and outputs the status of each object.
B: Create an S3 Inventory configuration on the S3 bucket. Include the appropriate status fields.
C: Provide the security team with an IAM user that has read access to the S3 bucket.
D: Use the AWS CLI to output a list of all objects in the S3 bucket.
question_zh:
一家公司在 Amazon S3 bucket 中维护一大批敏感数据。  
该公司的安全团队要求一名 SysOps 管理员帮助验证 S3 bucket 中所有当前对象是否都已加密。  
什么是满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案？
A_zh: 创建 一个 脚本 ， 那个 运行 对于 S3 bucket ， 并 输出 每个 对象 的 状态 。
B_zh: 在 S3 桶上创建一个 S3 Inventory 配置。包括适当的状态字段。
C_zh: 为安全团队提供具有对 S3 bucket 读取访问权限的 IAM 用户。
D_zh: 使用 AWS CLI 输出 所有 对象 在 S3 bucket 的 列表。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司在 Amazon S3 bucket 中维护一大批敏感数据。  
该公司的安全团队要求一名 SysOps 管理员帮助验证 S3 bucket 中所有当前对象是否都已加密。  
什么是满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案？

question: Users are periodically experiencing slow response times from a relational database. The database runs on a burstable Amazon EC2 instance with a 350 GB General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. A SysOps administrator monitors the EC2 instance in Amazon CloudWatch and observes that the VolumeReadOps metric drops to less than 10% of its peak value during the periods of slow response.  What should the SysOps administrator do to ensure consistently high performance?
A: Convert the gp2 volume to a General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS volume.
B: Convert the gp2 volume to a Cold HDD (sc1) EBS volume.
C: Convert the EC2 instance to a memory optimized instance type.
D: Activate unlimited mode on the EC2 instance.
question_zh:
用户们周期性地经历关系数据库的响应时间变慢。  
该数据库运行在一个可突发的 Amazon EC2 实例上，配备一个 350 GB 通用型 SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。  
一名 SysOps 管理员在 Amazon CloudWatch 中监控 EC2 实例，并观察到在响应变慢期间，VolumeReadOps 指标下降到其峰值的不到 10%。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以确保持续的高性能？
A_zh: 将 gp2 卷 转换 为 一般 目的 SSD (gp3) EBS 卷 。
B_zh: 将 gp2 卷转换为 Cold HDD (sc1) EBS 卷。
C_zh: 将 EC2 实例 转换 为 一个 内存 优化 实例 类型 。
D_zh: 在 EC2 实例上激活 unlimited 模式。
question_zh_zh:
用户们周期性地经历关系数据库的响应时间变慢。  
The users periodically experience the response time of the relational database slow down.  
该数据库运行在一个可突发的 Amazon EC2 实例上，配备一个 350 GB 通用型 SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。  
The database runs on a burstable Amazon EC2 instance, equipped with a 350 GB general purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume.  
一名 SysOps 管理员在 Amazon CloudWatch 中监控 EC2 实例，并观察到在响应变慢期间，VolumeReadOps 指标下降到其峰值的不到 10%。  
A SysOps administrator monitors the EC2 instance in Amazon CloudWatch, and observes that during the response slowdown, the VolumeReadOps metric drops to less than 10% of its peak.  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以确保持续的高性能？  
What should the SysOps administrator do to ensure sustained high performance?

question: A SysOps administrator is optimizing the cost of a workload. The workload is running in multiple AWS Regions and is using AWS Lambda with Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances for the computer. The overall usage is predictable. The amount of computer that is consumed in each Region varies, depending on the users' locations.  Which approach should the SysOps administrator use to optimize this workload?
A: Purchase Computer Savings Plans based on the usage during the past 30 days.
B: Purchase Convertible Reserved Instances by calculating the usage baseline.
C: Purchase EC2 Instance Savings Plans based on the usage during the past 30 days.
D: Purchase Standard Reserved Instances by calculating the usage baseline.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在优化一个工作负载的成本。  
The workload 正在多个 AWS Regions 运行，并且正在使用 AWS Lambda 与 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 进行计算。  
整体使用是可预测的。  
每个 Region 中消耗的计算量不同，取决于用户的位置。  
SysOps 管理员应使用哪种方法来优化这个工作负载？
A_zh: 根据过去 30 天的使用情况购买 Computer Savings Plans。
B_zh: 通过计算 usage baseline 购买 Convertible Reserved Instances 。
C_zh: 根据过去 30 天的使用情况购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plans。
D_zh: 通过计算 usage baseline 购买 Standard Reserved Instances。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在优化一个工作负载的成本。  
The workload 正在多个 AWS Regions 运行，并且正在使用 AWS Lambda 与 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 进行计算。  
整体使用是可预测的。  
每个 Region 中消耗的计算量不同，取决于用户的位置。  
SysOps 管理员应使用哪种方法来优化这个工作负载？

question: A software company runs a workload on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A SysOps administrator needs to define a custom health check for the EC2 instances.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution?
A: Set up each EC2 instance so that it writes its healthy/unhealthy status into a shared Amazon S3 bucket for the ALB to read.
B: Configure the health check on the ALB and ensure that the Health Check Path setting is correct.
C: Set up Amazon ElastiCache to track the EC2 instances as they scale in and out.
D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway health check to ensure custom checks on all of the EC2 instances.
question_zh: 一家软件公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行工作负载，位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面。 一名 SysOps 管理员需要为 EC2 实例定义一个自定义健康检查。 什么是最具操作效率的解决方案？
A_zh: 设置 每个 EC2 实例 以便 它 写入 它 的 健康/不健康 状态 到 一个 共享 的 Amazon S3 存储桶 以供 ALB 读取。
B_zh: 在 ALB 上配置健康检查，并确保 Health Check Path 设置是正确的。
C_zh: 设置 Amazon ElastiCache 以跟踪 EC2 实例，当它们缩放进入和退出。
D_zh: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway 健康检查，以确保对所有的 EC2 实例进行自定义检查。
question_zh_zh:
一家软件公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行工作负载，位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面。  
一名 SysOps 管理员需要为 EC2 实例定义一个自定义健康检查。  
什么是最具操作效率的解决方案？

question: A SysOps administrator is required to monitor free space on Amazon EBS volumes attached to Microsoft Windows-based Amazon EC2 instances within a company's account. The administrator must be alerted to potential issues.  What should the administrator do to receive email alerts before low storage space affects EC2 instance performance?
A: Use built-in Amazon CloudWatch metrics, and configure CloudWatch alarms and an Amazon SNS topic for email notifications.
B: Use AWS CloudTrail logs and configure the trail to send notifications to an Amazon SNS topic.
C: Use the Amazon CloudWatch agent to send disk space metrics, then set up CloudWatch alarms using an Amazon SNS topic.
D: Use AWS Trusted Advisor and enable email notification alerts for EC2 disk space.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员需要监控连接到公司账户内 Microsoft Windows 基于的 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon EBS 卷的空闲空间。  
管理员必须被提醒潜在的问题。  
管理员应该做什么以在低存储空间影响 EC2 实例性能之前接收电子邮件警报？
A_zh: 使用 内置 的 Amazon CloudWatch 指标， 和 配置 CloudWatch 警报 和 一个 Amazon SNS 主题 用于 电子邮件 通知。
B_zh: 使用 AWS CloudTrail 日志，并配置该 trail 以发送通知到一个 Amazon SNS 主题。
C_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch agent 发送 磁盘空间 指标， 然后 设置 CloudWatch 警报 使用 一个 Amazon SNS 主题。
D_zh: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 并启用电子邮件通知警报用于 EC2 磁盘空间。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员需要监控连接到公司账户内 Microsoft Windows 基于的 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon EBS 卷的空闲空间。  
管理员必须被提醒潜在的问题。  
管理员应该做什么以在低存储空间影响 EC2 实例性能之前接收电子邮件警报？

question: A company applies user-defined tags to resources that are associated with the company's AWS workloads. Twenty days after applying the tags, the company notices that it cannot use the tags to filter views in the AWS Cost Explorer console.  What is the reason for this issue?
A: It takes at least 30 days to be able to use tags to filter views in Cost Explorer.
B: The company has not activated the user-defined tags for cost allocation.
C: The company has not created an AWS Cost and Usage Report.
D: The company has not created a usage budget in AWS Budgets.
question_zh:
一家公司对与公司 AWS 工作负载相关联的资源应用用户定义的标签。  
二十天后，应用标签后，公司注意到它不能使用标签在 AWS Cost Explorer 控制台中过滤视图。  
这个问题的原因是什么？
A_zh: 在 Cost Explorer 中，使用标签过滤视图至少需要 30 天。
B_zh: 公司尚未激活用户定义的标签用于成本分配。
C_zh: 该公司尚未创建一个 AWS Cost and Usage Report。
D_zh: 该公司尚未在 AWS Budgets 中创建使用预算。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司对与公司 AWS 工作负载相关联的资源应用用户定义的标签。  
二十天后，应用标签后，公司注意到它不能使用标签在 AWS Cost Explorer 控制台中过滤视图。  
这个问题的原因是什么？

question: A company has a critical serverless application that uses multiple AWS Lambda functions. Each Lambda function generates 1 GB of log data daily in its own Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. The company's security team asks for a count of application errors, grouped by type, across all of the log groups.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Perform a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that uses the stats command and count function.
B: Perform a CloudWatch Logs search that uses the groupby keyword and count function.
C: Perform an Amazon Athena query that uses the SELECT and GROUP BY keywords.
D: Perform an Amazon RDS query that uses the SELECT and GROUP BY keywords.
question_zh:
一家公司有一个关键的无服务器应用程序，使用多个 AWS Lambda functions。  
每个 Lambda function 生成 1 GB 的日志数据每天在它自己的 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组中。  
该公司的安全团队要求按类型分组的应用程序错误数量，跨所有的日志组。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以满足这个要求？
A_zh: 执行一个 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询，该查询使用 stats 命令和 count 函数。
B_zh: 执行 一个 CloudWatch Logs 搜索 ， 它 使用 groupby 关键词 和 count 函数 。
C_zh: 执行 一个 Amazon Athena 查询 ， 它 使用 了 SELECT 和 GROUP BY 关键字 。
D_zh: 执行 一个 Amazon RDS 查询 ， 它 使用 了 SELECT 和 GROUP BY 关键字 。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司有一个关键的无服务器应用程序，使用多个 AWS Lambda functions。  
每个 Lambda function 生成 1 GB 的日志数据每天在它自己的 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组中。  
该公司的安全团队要求按类型分组的应用程序错误数量，跨所有的日志组。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以满足这个要求？

question: A company with multiple AWS accounts needs to obtain recommendations for AWS Lambda functions and identify optimal resource configurations for each Lambda function.  How should a SysOps administrator provide these recommendations?
A: Create an AWS Serverless Application Repository and export the Lambda function recommendations.
B: Enable AWS Compute Optimizer and export the Lambda function recommendations.
C: Enable all features of AWS Organizations and export the recommendations from AWS CloudTrail Insights.
D: Run AWS Trusted Advisor and export the Lambda function recommendations.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有多个 AWS 账户 需要 取得 建议 关于 AWS Lambda functions 和 识别 最佳 资源 配置 对于 每个 Lambda function 。  如何 应该 一个 SysOps administrator 提供 这些 建议？
A_zh: 创建 一个 AWS Serverless Application Repository 和 导出 Lambda function 推荐。
B_zh: 启用 AWS Compute Optimizer 和 导出 Lambda function 建议。
C_zh: 启用所有功能的 AWS Organizations 和 导出来自 AWS CloudTrail Insights 的建议。
D_zh: 运行 AWS Trusted Advisor 并导出 Lambda 函数建议。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司 拥有 多个 AWS 账户 需要 取得 建议 关于 AWS Lambda functions 和 识别 最佳 资源 配置 对于 每个 Lambda function 。  如何 应该 一个 SysOps administrator 提供 这些 建议？

question: A company uses AWS CloudFormation templates to deploy cloud infrastructure. An analysis of all the company's templates shows that the company has declared the same components in multiple templates. A SysOps administrator needs to create dedicated templates that have their own parameters and conditions for these common components.  Which solution will meet this requirement?
A: Develop a CloudFormation change set.
B: Develop CloudFormation macros.
C: Develop CloudFormation nested stacks.
D: Develop CloudFormation stack sets.
question_zh:
一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation templates 来部署云基础设施。  
一份分析所有公司的 templates 显示，  
该公司已经在多个 templates 中声明了相同的 components。  
一名 SysOps administrator 需要创建专用的 templates，  
这些 templates 拥有它们自己的 parameters 和 conditions，用于这些 common components。  
哪种解决方案将满足这个需求？
A_zh: 开发 一个 CloudFormation 变更集。
B_zh: 开发 CloudFormation 宏。
C_zh: 开发 CloudFormation 嵌套堆栈。
D_zh: 开发 CloudFormation stack sets。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation templates 来部署云基础设施。  
一份分析所有公司的 templates 显示，  
该公司已经在多个 templates 中声明了相同的 components。  
一名 SysOps administrator 需要创建专用的 templates，  
这些 templates 拥有它们自己的 parameters 和 conditions，用于这些 common components。  
哪种解决方案将满足这个需求？

question: A SysOps administrator is building a process for sharing Amazon RDS database snapshots between different accounts associated with different business units within the same company. All data must be encrypted at rest.  How should the administrator implement this process?
A: Write a script to download the encrypted snapshot, decrypt it using the AWS KMS encryption key used to encrypt the snapshot, then create a new volume in each account.
B: Update the key policy to grant permission to the AWS KMS encryption key used to encrypt the snapshot with all relevant accounts, then share the snapshot with those accounts.
C: Create an Amazon EC2 instance based on the snapshot, then save the instance's Amazon EBS volume as a snapshot and share it with the other accounts. Require each account owner to create a new volume from that snapshot and encrypt it.
D: Create a new unencrypted RDS instance from the encrypted snapshot, connect to the instance using SSH/RDP, export the database contents into a file, then share this file with the other accounts.
question_zh: 一名 SysOps 管理员正在建立一个用于在同一公司内不同业务单元关联的不同账户之间共享 Amazon RDS 数据库快照的流程。所有数据必须在静态时加密。 管理员应该如何实现这个流程？
A_zh: 编写一个脚本，用于下载加密的快照，使用用于加密快照的 AWS KMS 加密密钥对其进行解密，然后在每个账户中创建一个新卷。
B_zh: 更新 密钥策略 以授予 权限 给 AWS KMS 加密密钥 用于 加密 快照 与 所有 相关账户，然后 分享 快照 给 那些 账户。
C_zh: 基于快照创建一个 Amazon EC2 实例， 然后将该实例的 Amazon EBS 卷作为快照保存，并与其他账户共享， 要求每个账户所有者从该快照创建一个新卷并对其进行加密。
D_zh: 从加密的快照创建一个新的未加密的 RDS 实例，连接到该实例使用 SSH/RDP，将数据库内容导出到一个文件，然后与其他账户共享这个文件。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在建立一个用于在同一公司内不同业务单元关联的不同账户之间共享 Amazon RDS 数据库快照的流程。  
所有数据必须在静态时加密。  
管理员应该如何实现这个流程？

question: A SysOps administrator configures an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint in a VPC. The private subnets inside the VPC do not have outbound internet access. User logs in to an Amazon EC2 instance in one of the private subnets and cannot upload a file to an Amazon S3 bucket in the same AWS Region.  Which solution will solve this problem?
A: Update the EC2 instance role policy to include s3:PutObject access to the target S3 bucket.
B: Update the EC2 security group to allow outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 for port 80.
C: Update the EC2 subnet route table to include the S3 prefix list destination routes to the S3 gateway endpoint.
D: Update the S3 bucket policy to allow s3:PutObject access from the private subnet CIDR block.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员在 VPC 中配置了一个 Amazon S3 gateway endpoint。  
VPC 内部的私有子网没有出站互联网访问权限。  
用户登录到私有子网中的一个 Amazon EC2 实例，并且无法将文件上传到同一 AWS Region 中的 Amazon S3 bucket。  
哪种解决方案可以解决这个问题？
A_zh: 更新 EC2 实例角色策略 以 包含 s3:PutObject 访问 权限 到 目标 S3 桶。
B_zh: 更新 EC2 security group 以允许 outbound traffic 到 0.0.0.0/0 用于 port 80。
C_zh: 更新 EC2 子网路由表 以 包含 S3 前缀列表 目的地 路由 到 S3 网关端点。
D_zh: 更新  the  S3  bucket  policy  以允许  s3:PutObject  访问  从  the  private  subnet  CIDR  block  。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员在 VPC 中配置了一个 Amazon S3 gateway endpoint。  
VPC 内部的私有子网没有出站互联网访问权限。  
用户登录到私有子网中的一个 Amazon EC2 实例，并且无法将文件上传到同一 AWS Region 中的 Amazon S3 bucket。  
哪种解决方案可以解决这个问题？

question: A company uses Amazon S3 to aggregate raw video footage from various media teams across the US. The company recently expanded into new geographies in Europe and Australia. The technical teams located in Europe and Australia reported delays when uploading large video files into the destination S3 bucket in the United States.  What are the MOST cost effective ways to increase upload speeds into the S3 bucket? (Choose two.)
A: Create multiple AWS Direct Connect connections between AWS and branch offices in Europe and Australia for file uploads into the destination S3 bucket.
B: Create multiple AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections between AWS and branch offices in Europe and Australia for file uploads into the destination S3 bucket.
C: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration for file uploads into the destination S3 bucket.
D: Use AWS Global Accelerator for file uploads into the destination S3 bucket from the branch offices in Europe and Australia.
E: Use multipart uploads for file uploads into the destination S3 bucket from the branch offices in Europe and Australia.
question_zh:
一家公司使用 Amazon S3 来汇总来自美国各个媒体团队的原始视频素材。  
The company 最近扩展到欧洲和澳大利亚的新地理区域。  
The technical teams 位于欧洲和澳大利亚，报告在将大型视频文件上传到位于美国的目标 S3 bucket 时出现延迟。  
What are the MOST cost effective ways to increase upload speeds into the S3 bucket?（Choose two.）
A_zh: 在 AWS 和欧洲以及澳大利亚的分支机构之间创建多个 AWS Direct Connect 连接，用于将文件上传到目标 S3 bucket。
B_zh: 在 AWS 和欧洲以及澳大利亚的分支机构之间创建多个 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接，用于将文件上传到目标 S3 bucket。
C_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 用于 文件 上传 到 目的地 S3 bucket。
D_zh: 使用 AWS Global Accelerator 用于 文件上传 到 目的地 S3 存储桶 从 分支办公室 在 欧洲 和 澳大利亚。
E_zh: 使用 multipart 上传用于文件上传到  destination S3 bucket 从 欧洲 和 澳大利亚 的 分支机构。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司使用 Amazon S3 来汇总来自美国各个媒体团队的原始视频素材。  
The company 最近扩展到欧洲和澳大利亚的新地理区域。  
The technical teams 位于欧洲和澳大利亚，报告在将大型视频文件上传到位于美国的目标 S3 bucket 时出现延迟。

question: A company's SysOps administrator maintains a highly available environment. The environment includes Amazon EC2 instances and an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ database. The SysOps administrator needs to decrease the failover time of the RDS database by at least 10%.  Which solution will meet this requirement?

B: Modify the RDS cluster to run in a single Availability Zone.
C: Create a read replica in another AWS Region. Promote the read replica in case of failure.
D: Create an RDS proxy. Point the application to the proxy endpoint.

question: A company's VPC has connectivity to an on-premises data center through an AWS Site-to-Site VPN. The company needs Amazon EC2 instances in the VPC to send DNS queries for example.com to the DNS servers in the data center.  Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_zh:

question: A company's SysOps administrator has created an Amazon EC2 instance with custom software that will be used as a template for all new EC2 instances across multiple AWS accounts. The Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to the EC2 instance are encrypted with AWS managed keys.  The SysOps administrator creates an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the custom EC2 instance and plans to share the AMI with the company's other AWS accounts. The company requires that all AMIs are encrypted with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys and that only authorized AWS accounts can access the shared AMIs.  Which solution will securely share the AMI with the other AWS accounts?
A: In the account where the AMI was created, create a customer managed KMS key. Modify the key policy to provide kms:DescribeKey, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:CreateGrant, and kms:Decrypt permissions to the AWS accounts that the AMI will be shared with. Modify the AMI permissions to specify the AWS account numbers that the AMI will be shared with.
B: In the account where the AMI was created, create a customer managed KMS key. Modify the key policy to provide kms:DescribeKey, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:CreateGrant, and kms:Decrypt permissions to the AWS accounts that the AMI will be shared with. Create a copy of the AMI, and specify the KMS key. Modify the permissions on the copied AMI to specify the AWS account numbers that the AMI will be shared with.
C: In the account where the AMI was created, create a customer managed KMS key. Modify the key policy to provide kms:DescribeKey, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:CreateGrant, and kms:Decrypt permissions to the AWS accounts that the AMI will be shared with. Create a copy of the AMI, and specify the KMS key Modify the permissions on the copied AMI to make it public.
D: In the account where the AMI was created, modify the key policy of the AWS managed key to provide kms:DescribeKey, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:CreateGrant, and kms:Decrypt permissions to the AWS accounts that the AMI will be shared with. Modify the AMI permissions to specify the AWS account numbers that the AMI will be shared with.
question_zh:
一家公司 的 SysOps 管理员 创建 了 一个 Amazon EC2 实例 ， 使用 自定义 软件 ， 将 作为 模板 ， 用于 所有 新 的 EC2 实例 ， 跨 多个 AWS 账户 。  
该 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷 被 附加 到 EC2 实例 ， 并且 被 使用 AWS 管理的 密钥 加密 。  
SysOps 管理员 创建 了 一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) ， 以 该 自定义 EC2 实例 ， 并 计划 与 公司的 其他 AWS 账户 共享 该 AMI 。  
公司 要求 所有 AMI 都 必须 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥 加密 ， 并且 只有 授权 的 AWS 账户 才 能 访问 共享 的 AMI 。

在创建 AMI 的账户中，创建一个客户管理的 KMS 密钥。  
修改密钥策略以向将共享 AMI 的 AWS 账户提供 kms:DescribeKey、kms:ReEncrypt*、kms:CreateGrant 和 kms:Decrypt 权限。  
修改 AMI 权限以指定将共享 AMI 的 AWS 账户号码。
B_zh:
在创建 AMI 的账户中，创建一个客户管理的 KMS 密钥。  
修改密钥策略以向将共享 AMI 的 AWS 账户提供 kms:DescribeKey、kms:ReEncrypt*、kms:CreateGrant 和 kms:Decrypt 权限。

修改副本 AMI 的权限，以指定将共享该 AMI 的 AWS 账户编号。
C_zh:
在创建 AMI 的账户中，创建一个客户管理的 KMS 密钥。  
修改密钥策略以向将共享 AMI 的 AWS 账户提供 kms:DescribeKey、kms:ReEncrypt*、kms:CreateGrant 和 kms:Decrypt 权限。

修改 AMI 权限，以指定将要共享该 AMI 的 AWS 账户编号。

question: A company is migrating its production file server to AWS. All data that is stored on the file server must remain accessible if an Availability Zone becomes unavailable or when system maintenance is performed. Users must be able to interact with the file server through the SMB protocol. Users also must have the ability to manage file permissions by using Windows ACLs.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create a single AWS Storage Gateway file gateway.
B: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ file system.
C: Deploy two AWS Storage Gateway file gateways across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer in front of the file gateways.
D: Deploy two Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Single-AZ 2 file systems. Configure Microsoft Distributed File System Replication (DFSR).

A_zh: 创建 一个 一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件 网关。
B_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 多可用区（Multi-AZ）文件系统。
C_zh: 在两个 Availability Zones 部署两个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关。 在文件网关前配置一个 Application Load Balancer。
D_zh: 部署两个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 单可用区 2 文件系统。配置 Microsoft 分布式文件系统复制 (DFSR)。

All data stored on the file server must remain accessible,

question: A SysOps administrator needs to create alerts that are based on the read and write metrics of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. A: Install and configure the CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instance to capture the desired metrics.
B: Install and configure AWS Systems Manager Agent on the EC2 instance to capture the desired metrics.
C: Reconfigure the CloudWatch alarms to use the VolumeReadBytes metric and the VolumeWriteBytes metric for the EBS volumes.

question_zh:

一款安装在 EC2 实例上的自定义监控工具，具有相同的警报配置，显示卷指标已超过阈值。

question: A company recently moved its server infrastructure to Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to track instance memory utilization and available disk space.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?

question: A SysOps administrator is setting up a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group for an application. question_zh:

question: A company has turned on server access logging for all of its existing Amazon S3 buckets. The company wants to implement a solution to monitor the logging settings for new and existing S3 buckets. The solution must remediate any S3 buckets that do not have logging turned on.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A: Track the logging information by using AWS CloudTrail. Launch an AWS Lambda function for remediation.
B: Configure automatic remediation in AWS Config by using the s3-bucket-logging-enabled rule.

question: A company is running Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group. The instances process messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The Auto Scaling group is set to scale based on the number of messages in the queue. Messages can take up to 12 hours to process completely. A SysOps administrator must ensure that instances are not interrupted during message processing.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?
A: Enable instance scale-in protection for the specific instance in the Auto Scaling group at the start of message processing by calling the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling API from the processing script. Disable instance scale-in protection after message processing is complete by calling the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling API from the processing script.
B: Set the Auto Scaling group's termination policy to OldestInstance.
C: Set the Auto Scaling group's termination policy to OldestLaunchConfiguration.
D: Suspend the Launch and Terminate scaling processes for the specific instance in the Auto Scaling group at the start of message processing by calling the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling API from the processing script. Resume the scaling processes after message processing is complete by calling the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling API from the processing script.

The Auto Scaling 组 被设置为 根据 队列中的 messages 数量进行扩缩。

在消息处理完成后，通过从处理脚本调用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling API，禁用实例缩减保护。

C_zh: 将 Auto Scaling 组的终止策略设置为 OldestLaunchConfiguration。

question: A company manages a set of accounts on AWS by using AWS Organizations. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to meet these requirements?

Configure Security Hub to run the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark scans.
B: Run the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark across all accounts by using Amazon Inspector.
C: Designate a central security account as the Amazon GuardDuty administrator account. Create a script that sends an invitation from the GuardDuty administrator account and accepts the invitation from the member account. Run the script every time a new account is created. Configure GuardDuty to run the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark scans.

question: A company has an application that uses an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. A recent incident that involved an application logic error corrupted several files. B: Create a second EFS file system in another AWS Region. Configure AWS DataSync to copy the data to the backup file system. Recover files by copying them from the backup EFS file system.

question: A company migrates a write-once, ready-many (WORM) drive to an Amazon S3 bucket that has S3 Object Lock configured in governance mode. During the migration, the company copies unneeded data to the S3 bucket.  A SysOps administrator attempts to delete the unneeded data from the S3 bucket by using the AWS CLI. However, the SysOps administrator receives an error.  Which combination of steps should the SysOps administrator take to successfully delete the unneeded data? (Choose two.)
A: Increase the Retain Until Date.
B: Assume a role that has the s3:BypassLegalRetention permission.
C: Assume a role that has the s3:BypassGovernanceRetention permission.
D: Include the x-amz-bypass-governance-retention:true header in the request when issuing the delete command.
E: Include the x-amz-bypass-legal-retention:true header in the request when issuing the delete command.
question_zh:
一家公司将一次写入、准备多（WORM）驱动器迁移到配置了 S3 Object Lock 的 Amazon S3 bucket，且处于 governance 模式。  
在迁移过程中，该公司将不需要的数据复制到 S3 bucket。  
一名 SysOps 管理员试图使用 AWS CLI 删除 S3 bucket 中的不需要的数据。  
然而，SysOps 管理员收到一个错误。  
SysOps 管理员应采取哪些步骤组合以成功删除不需要的数据？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 增加 保留 直到 日期。
B_zh: 假设 一个 拥有 s3:BypassLegalRetention 权限 的 角色。
C_zh: 假设 一个 拥有 s3:BypassGovernanceRetention 权限 的 角色。
D_zh: 在发出 delete 命令 时，包含 x-amz-bypass-governance-retention:true 头部 在 请求 中。
E_zh: 在发出 delete 命令时，包含 x-amz-bypass-legal-retention:true 头部在请求中。

question: A company needs to view a list of security groups that are open to the internet on port 3389.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to scan security groups and report unrestricted access on port 3389.
B: Configure a service control policy (SCP) to identify security groups that allow unrestricted access on port 3389.
C: Use AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer to find any instances that have unrestricted access on port 3389.

question: A company website contains a web tier and a database tier on AWS. The web tier consists of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones. The database tier runs on an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. The database subnet network ACLs are restricted to only the web subnets that need access to the database. The web subnets use the default network ACL with the default rules.  The company's operations team has added a third subnet to the Auto Scaling group configuration. After an Auto Scaling event occurs, some users report that they intermittently receive an error message. The error message states that the server cannot connect to the database. The operations team has confirmed that the route tables are correct and that the required ports are open on all security groups.  Which combination of actions should a SysOps administrator take so that the web servers can communicate with the DB instance? (Choose two.)
A: On the default ACL, create inbound Allow rules of type TCP with the ephemeral port range and the source as the database subnets.
B: On the default ACL, create outbound Allow rules of type MySQL/Aurora (3306). Specify the destinations as the database subnets.
C: On the network ACLs for the database subnets, create an inbound Allow rule of type MySQL/Aurora (3306). Specify the source as the third web subnet.
D: On the network ACLs for the database subnets, create an outbound Allow rule of type TCP with the ephemeral port range and the destination as the third web subnet.
E: On the network ACLs for the database subnets, create an outbound Allow rule of type MySQL/Aurora (3306). Specify the destination as the third web subnet.

question: A SysOps administrator is preparing to deploy an application to Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The application requires dependencies to be installed. Application updates are issued weekly.  The SysOps administrator needs to implement a solution to incorporate the application updates on a regular basis. The solution also must conduct a vulnerability scan during Amazon Machine Image (AMI) creation.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create a script that uses Packer. Schedule a cron job to run the script.
B: Install the application and its dependencies on an EC2 instance. Create an AMI of the EC2 instance.
C: Use EC2 Image Builder with a custom recipe to install the application and its dependencies.
D: Invoke the EC2 CreateImage API operation by using an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在准备将一个应用程序部署到在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例。  
The application 需要依赖项被安装。  
应用程序更新每周发布一次。  
该 SysOps 管理员需要实现一个解决方案，以定期合并应用程序更新。  
该解决方案还必须在 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 创建期间进行漏洞扫描。  
什么是满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案？
A_zh: 创建 一个 脚本 ， 它 使用 Packer 。 安排 一个 cron 任务 来 运行 脚本 。
B_zh: 在 EC2 实例上安装应用程序及其依赖项。 创建 EC2 实例的 AMI。
C_zh: 使用 EC2 Image Builder 与 自定义配方 来 安装 应用程序 和 它 的 依赖项。
D_zh: 通过使用 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则 调用 EC2 CreateImage API 操作。

question: An AWS CloudFormation template creates an Amazon RDS instance. This template is used to build up development environments as needed and then delete the stack when the environment is no longer required. The RDS-persisted data must be retained for further use, even after the CloudFormation stack is deleted.  How can this be achieved in a reliable and efficient way?
A: Write a script to continue backing up the RDS instance every five minutes.
B: Create an AWS Lambda function to take a snapshot of the RDS instance, and manually invoke the function before deleting the stack.
C: Use the Snapshot Deletion Policy in the CloudFormation template definition of the RDS instance.
D: Create a new CloudFormation template to perform backups of the RDS instance, and run this template before deleting the stack.
question_zh:
一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板创建一个 Amazon RDS 实例。  
This template is used to build up development environments as needed and then delete the stack when the environment is no longer required.  
该模板用于根据需要建立开发环境，然后在环境不再需要时删除堆栈。  
The RDS-persisted data must be retained for further use, even after the CloudFormation stack is deleted.  
即使在 CloudFormation 堆栈被删除后，RDS 持久化的数据也必须被保留以供进一步使用。  
How can this be achieved in a reliable and efficient way?  
如何以可靠且高效的方式实现这一点？
A_zh: 编写 一个 脚本 以 继续 备份 RDS 实例 每 五 分钟 。
B_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数以拍摄 RDS 实例的快照，且手动调用该函数在删除堆栈之前。
C_zh: 在 CloudFormation 模板定义中使用 Snapshot Deletion Policy 在 RDS 实例。
D_zh: 创建 一个 新的 CloudFormation 模板 以 执行 备份 的 RDS 实例 ， 和 运行 这个 模板 在 删除 这个 堆栈 之前 。

question: A SysOps administrator needs to provision a new fleet of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group. The Auto Scaling group will use a wide range of instance types. B: Launch the Spot Instances by using the diversified strategy.

question: A SysOps administrator creates a custom Amazon Machine Image (AMI) in the eu-west-2 Region and uses the AMI to launch Amazon EC2 instances. The SysOps administrator needs to use the same AMI to launch EC2 instances in two other Regions: us-east-1 and us-east-2.  What must the SysOps administrator do to use the custom AMI in the additional Regions?
A: Copy the AMI to the additional Regions.
B: Make the AMI public in the Community AMIs section of the AWS Management Console.
C: Share the AMI to the additional Regions. Assign the required access permissions.

该 SysOps 管理员需要使用相同的 AMI 在另外两个区域：us-east-1 和 us-east-2 启动 EC2 实例。

question: A company is building an interactive application for personal finance. The application stores financial data in Amazon S3, and the data must be encrypted. The company does not want to provide its own encryption keys. However, the company wants to maintain an audit trail that shows when an encryption key was used and who used the key.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Use client-side encryption with client-provided keys. Upload the encrypted user data to Amazon S3.
B: Use server-side encryption with S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the user data on Amazon S3.
C: Use server-side encryption with customer-provided encryption keys (SSE-C) to encrypt the user data on Amazon S3.
D: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt the user data on Amazon S3.
question_zh:
一家公司正在构建一个用于个人理财的交互式应用程序。  
该应用程序将财务数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，且数据必须被加密。  
该公司不想提供自己的加密密钥。  
然而，该公司希望维护一个审计轨迹，显示何时使用了加密密钥以及谁使用了该密钥。  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 使用 client-side encryption 与 client-provided keys。上传 加密的 用户数据 到 Amazon S3。
B_zh: 使用 server-side encryption 与 S3 管理的加密密钥（SSE-S3） 来加密 用户数据 在 Amazon S3。
C_zh: 使用 server-side encryption with customer-provided encryption keys (SSE-C) 来加密 Amazon S3 上的用户数据。
D_zh: 使用 server-side encryption 与 AWS KMS 管理的加密密钥（SSE-KMS） 来加密 用户数据 在 Amazon S3。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司正在构建一个用于个人理财的交互式应用程序。  
The company is building an interactive application for personal finance.  
该应用程序将财务数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，且数据必须被加密。  
The application will store financial data in Amazon S3, and the data must be encrypted.  
该公司不想提供自己的加密密钥。  
The company does not want to provide its own encryption keys.  
然而，该公司希望维护一个审计轨迹，显示何时使用了加密密钥以及谁使用了该密钥。  
However, the company wants to maintain an audit trail showing when the encryption keys were used and who used them.  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？  
Which solution can meet these requirements?

question: A company has an AWS CloudFormation template that creates an Amazon S3 bucket. A user authenticates to the corporate AWS account with their Active Directory credentials and attempts to deploy the CloudFormation template. However, the stack creation fails.  Which factors could cause this failure? (Choose two.)
A: The user's IAM policy does not allow the cloudformation:CreateStack action.
B: The user's IAM policy does not allow the cloudformation:CreateStackSet action.
C: The user's IAM policy does not allow the s3:CreateBucket action.
D: The user's IAM policy explicitly denies the s3:ListBucket action.
E: The user's IAM policy explicitly denies the s3:PutObject action.
question_zh:
一家公司拥有一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，该模板创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。  
一名用户使用他们的 Active Directory 凭证对公司 AWS 账户进行身份验证，并试图部署 CloudFormation 模板。  
然而，堆栈创建失败。  
哪些因素可能导致此失败？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 用户的 IAM 政策 不允许 cloudformation:CreateStack 操作。
B_zh: 用户的 IAM 政策 不允许 cloudformation:CreateStackSet 动作。
C_zh: 用户的 IAM 政策 不允许 s3:CreateBucket 操作。

E_zh: 用户的 IAM 政策 明确 拒绝 了 s3:PutObject 操作。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司拥有一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，该模板创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。  
一名用户使用他们的 Active Directory 凭证对公司 AWS 账户进行身份验证，并试图部署 CloudFormation 模板。

哪些因素可能导致此失败？（选择两个。）

question: An Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB cluster has automated backups turned on with a 7-day retention period. A SysOps administrator needs to create a new RDS DB cluster by using data that is no more than 24 hours old from the original DB cluster.  Which solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)
A: Identify the most recent automated snapshot. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS DB cluster.
B: Back up the database to Amazon S3 by using native database backup tools. Create a new RDS DB cluster and restore the data to the new RDS DB cluster.
C: Create a read replica instance in the original RDS DB cluster. Promote the read replica to a standalone DB cluster.
D: Create a new RDS DB cluster. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data from the current RDS DB cluster to the newly created RDS DB cluster.
E: Use the pg_dump utility to export data from the original RDS DB cluster to an Amazon EC2 instance. Create a new RDS DB cluster. Use the pg_restore utility to import the data from the EC2 instance to the new RDS DB cluster.
question_zh:
一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB 集群已经开启了自动备份，保留期为 7 天。  
一个 SysOps 管理员需要使用不超过 24 小时旧的原始 DB 集群中的数据，创建一个新的 RDS DB 集群。  
哪些解决方案可以以最少的操作开销满足这些要求？（选择两个。）
A_zh:
识别 the most recent automated snapshot。  
还原 the snapshot 到 a new RDS DB cluster。
B_zh: 使用原生数据库备份工具将数据库备份到 Amazon S3。创建一个新的 RDS DB 集群并将数据还原到新的 RDS DB 集群。
C_zh: 在原始的 RDS DB 集群中创建一个只读副本实例。将只读副本提升为一个独立的 DB 集群。
D_zh: 创建一个新的 RDS DB 集群。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据从当前的 RDS DB 集群迁移到新创建的 RDS DB 集群。
E_zh: 使用 pg_dump 工具将数据从原始 RDS DB 集群导出到 Amazon EC2 实例。创建一个新的 RDS DB 集群。使用 pg_restore 工具将数据从 EC2 实例导入到新的 RDS DB 集群。

哪些解决方案可以以最少的操作开销满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

question: A company is managing a website with a global user base hosted on Amazon EC2 with an Application Load Balancer (ALB). To reduce the load on the web servers, a SysOps administrator configures an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin. After a week of monitoring the solution, the administrator notices that requests are still being served by the ALB and there is no change in the web server load.  What are possible causes for this problem? (Choose two.)
A: CloudFront does not have the ALB configured as the origin access identity.
B: The DNS is still pointing to the ALB instead of the CloudFront distribution.
C: The ALB security group is not permitting inbound traffic from CloudFront.
D: The default, minimum, and maximum Time to Live (TTL) are set to 0 seconds on the CloudFront distribution.
E: The target groups associated with the ALB are configured for sticky sessions.
question_zh:
一家公司正在管理一个具有全球用户基础的网站，托管在 Amazon EC2 上，使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。为了减少对 web 服务器的负载，一名 SysOps 管理员配置了一个 Amazon CloudFront 分发，将 ALB 作为源。经过一周的监控，管理员注意到请求仍然由 ALB 提供服务，且 web 服务器的负载没有变化。  
可能导致这个问题的原因有哪些？（选择两个。）
A_zh: CloudFront 不具有 配置为 ALB 作为 源访问身份。
B_zh: DNS 仍然 指向 指向  ALB  而不是  而不是  CloudFront  分发。
C_zh: ALB 安全组 不允许 传入 流量 从 CloudFront 。
D_zh: 默认的、最小的、和最大的 Time to Live (TTL) 被设置为 0 秒 在 CloudFront 分发。
E_zh: 与 ALB 相关联的目标组被配置为粘性会话。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司正在管理一个具有全球用户基础的网站，托管在 Amazon EC2 上，使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。  
为了减少对 web 服务器的负载，一名 SysOps 管理员配置了一个 Amazon CloudFront 分发，将 ALB 作为源。  
经过一周的监控，管理员注意到请求仍然由 ALB 提供服务，且 web 服务器的负载没有变化。  
可能导致这个问题的原因有哪些？（选择两个。）

question: A SysOps administrator needs to configure the Amazon Route 53 hosted zone for example.com and www.example.com to point to an Application Load Balancer (ALB).  Which combination of actions should the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
A: Configure an A record for example.com to point to the IP address of the ALB.
B: Configure an A record for www.example.com to point to the IP address of the ALB.
C: Configure an alias record for example.com to point to the CNAME of the ALB.
D: Configure an alias record for www.example.com to point to the Route 53 example.com record.
E: Configure a CNAME record for example.com to point to the CNAME of the ALB.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员需要配置 Amazon Route 53 托管区域为 example.com 和 www.example.com 指向一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。  
哪一组合的操作应该 SysOps 管理员采取以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 为 example.com 配置一个 A 记录 指向 ALB 的 IP 地址。
B_zh: 为 www.example.com 配置一个 A 记录 指向 ALB 的 IP 地址。

D_zh: 为 www.example.com 配置一个别名记录指向 Route 53 example.com 记录。
E_zh: 为 example.com 配置一个 CNAME 记录 指向 ALB 的 CNAME。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员需要配置 Amazon Route 53 托管区域为 example.com 和 www.example.com 指向一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。  
哪一组合的操作应该 SysOps 管理员采取以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

question: A company has a hybrid environment. The company has set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the company's on-premises data center and a workload that runs in a VPC. The company uses Amazon Route 53 for DNS on AWS. The company uses a private hosted zone to manage DNS names for a set of services that are hosted on AWS.  The company wants the on-premises servers to use Route 53 for DNS resolution of the private hosted zone.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create a Route 53 inbound endpoint. Ensure that security groups and routing allow the traffic from the on-premises data center. Configure the DNS server on the on-premises network to conditionally forward DNS queries for the private hosted zone's domain name to the IP addresses of the inbound endpoint.
B: Create a Route 53 outbound endpoint. Ensure that security groups and routing allow the traffic from the VPC. Configure the DNS server on the on-premises network to conditionally forward DNS queries for the private hosted zone's domain name to the IP addresses of the outbound endpoint.
C: Edit the private hosted zone in Route 53 with a TXT record that references the on-premises DNS servers. Configure the DNS server on the on-premises network to conditionally forward DNS queries for the private hosted zone's domain name to the base of the VPC CIDR IPv4 network range, plus two.
D: Edit the private hosted zone in Route 53 with a PTR record that references the on-premises DNS servers. Configure the DNS server on the on-premises network to conditionally forward DNS queries for the private hosted zone's domain name to the base of the VPC CIDR IPv4 network range, plus two.
question_zh:
一家公司拥有一个混合环境。  
The company has set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the company's on-premises data center and a workload that runs in a VPC.  
该公司在AWS上使用Amazon Route 53进行DNS。  
The company uses a private hosted zone to manage DNS names for a set of services that are hosted on AWS.  
该公司希望本地服务器使用Route 53进行私有托管区域的DNS解析。  
The company wants the on-premises servers to use Route 53 for DNS resolution of the private hosted zone.  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个 Route 53 inbound endpoint。确保安全组和路由允许来自本地数据中心的流量。配置本地网络上的 DNS 服务器，以有条件地转发私有托管区域的域名的 DNS 查询到 inbound endpoint 的 IP 地址。
B_zh: 创建一个 Route 53 出站端点。确保安全组和路由允许来自 VPC 的流量。配置本地网络上的 DNS 服务器，以有条件地转发私有托管区域的域名的 DNS 查询到出站端点的 IP 地址。
C_zh:
在 Route 53 中编辑私有托管区域，添加一个引用本地 DNS 服务器的 TXT 记录。  
在本地网络上配置 DNS 服务器，以有条件地转发针对私有托管区域域名的 DNS 查询到 VPC CIDR IPv4 网络范围的基础，加上两个。
D_zh:
在 Route 53 中编辑私有托管区域，添加一个 PTR 记录，引用本地 DNS 服务器。  
在本地网络上配置 DNS 服务器，以有条件地转发针对私有托管区域的域名的 DNS 查询到 VPC CIDR IPv4 网络范围的基础，加上两个。

该公司在AWS上使用Amazon Route 53进行DNS。

哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator is evaluating Amazon Route 53 DNS options to address concerns about high availability for an on-premises website. The website consists of two servers: a primary active server and a secondary passive server. Route 53 should route traffic to the primary server if the associated health check returns 2xx or 3xx HTTP codes. All other traffic should be directed to the secondary passive server. The failover record type, set ID, and routing policy have been set appropriately for both primary and secondary servers.  Which next step should be taken to configure Route 53?
A: Create an A record for each server. Associate the records with the Route 53 HTTP health check.
B: Create an A record for each server. Associate the records with the Route 53 TCP health check.
C: Create an alias record for each server with evaluate target health set to yes. Associate the records with the Route 53 HTTP health check.
D: Create an alias record for each server with evaluate target health set to yes. Associate the records with the Route 53 TCP health check.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在评估 Amazon Route 53 DNS 选项，以解决关于高可用性的问题，针对一个 on-premises 网站。  
The website 由两个服务器组成：一个 primary active 服务器和一个 secondary passive 服务器。  
Route 53 应该将流量路由到 primary 服务器，如果相关的 health check 返回 2xx 或 3xx HTTP 代码。  
所有其他流量都应该被引导到 secondary passive 服务器。  
failover 记录类型、set ID 和 routing policy 已经为 primary 和 secondary 服务器适当设置。  
哪个下一步应该采取以配置 Route 53？
A_zh: 为每个服务器创建一个 A 记录。将这些记录与 Route 53 HTTP 健康检查关联。
B_zh: 为每个服务器创建一个 A 记录。将这些记录与 Route 53 TCP 健康检查关联。
C_zh: 为每个服务器创建一个别名记录，评估目标健康设置为是。将这些记录与 Route 53 HTTP 健康检查关联。
D_zh: 为每个服务器创建一个别名记录，evaluate target health 设置为 yes。将这些记录与 Route 53 TCP 健康检查关联。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在评估 Amazon Route 53 DNS 选项，以解决关于高可用性的问题，针对一个 on-premises 网站。  
The website 由两个服务器组成：一个 primary active 服务器和一个 secondary passive 服务器。  
Route 53 应该将流量路由到 primary 服务器，如果相关的 health check 返回 2xx 或 3xx HTTP 代码。  
所有其他流量都应该被引导到 secondary passive 服务器。  
failover 记录类型、set ID 和 routing policy 已经为 primary 和 secondary 服务器适当设置。

question: An Amazon EC2 instance is running an application that uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. A SysOps administrator must ensure that the application can read, write, and delete messages from the SQS queues.  Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure manner?
A: Create an IAM user with an IAM policy that allows the sqs:SendMessage permission, the sqs:ReceiveMessage permission, and the sqs:DeleteMessage permission to the appropriate queues. Embed the IAM user's credentials in the application's configuration
B: Create an IAM user with an IAM policy that allows the sqs:SendMessage permission, the sqs:RecelveMessage permission, and the sqs:DeleteMessage permission to the appropriate queues. Export the IAM user's access key and secret access key as environment variables on the EC2 instance.
C: Create and associate an IAM role that allows EC2 instances to call AWS services. Attach an IAM policy to the role that allows sqs:* permissions to the appropriate queues.
D: Create and associate an IAM role that allows EC2 instances to call AWS services. Attach an IAM policy to the role that allows the sqs:SendMessage permission, the sqs:ReceiveMessage permission, and the sqs:DeleteMessage permission to the appropriate queues.
question_zh:
一个 Amazon EC2 实例正在运行一个使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列的应用程序。  
一个 SysOps 管理员必须确保该应用程序能够从 SQS 队列中读取、写入和删除消息。  
哪种解决方案将以最安全的方式满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个 IAM 用户，具有允许 sqs:SendMessage 权限、sq s:ReceiveMessage 权限和 sqs:DeleteMessage 权限的 IAM 策略，适用于相应的队列。将 IAM 用户的凭证嵌入到应用程序的配置中。
B_zh: 创建一个具有允许 sqs:SendMessage 权限、sq s:RecelveMessage 权限和 sqs:DeleteMessage 权限的 IAM 用户，适当的队列。将 IAM 用户的访问密钥和秘密访问密钥导出为在 EC2 实例上的环境变量。
C_zh: 创建并关联一个 IAM 角色，该角色允许 EC2 实例调用 AWS 服务。附加一个 IAM 政策到该角色，该政策允许 sqs:* 权限到适当的队列。
D_zh:
创建并关联一个 IAM 角色，该角色允许 EC2 实例调用 AWS 服务。  
将一个 IAM 政策附加到该角色，该政策允许 sqs:SendMessage 权限、sqs:ReceiveMessage 权限，以及 sqs:DeleteMessage 权限到适当的队列。
question_zh_zh:
一个 Amazon EC2 实例 正在 运行 一个 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列 的 应用程序。  
一个 SysOps 管理员 必须 确保 该 应用程序 能够 从 SQS 队列 中 读取、写入 和 删除 消息。  
哪 种 解决方案 将 以 最 安全 的 方式 满足 这些 要求？

question: A SysOps administrator needs to configure an Amazon S3 bucket to host a web application. The SysOps administrator has created the S3 bucket and has copied the static files for the web application to the S3 bucket.  The company has a policy that all $3 buckets must not be public.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket as an origin with an origin access identity (OAI). Give the OAI the s3:GetObject permission in the S3 bucket policy.
B: Configure static website hosting in the S3 bucket. Use Amazon Route 53 to create a DNS CNAME to point to the S3 website endpoint.
C: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Change the protocol to HTTPS in the ALB listener configuration. Forward the traffic to the S3 bucket.
D: Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Set up a listener configuration for port 443. Set the endpoint type to forward the traffic to the S3 bucket.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员需要配置一个 Amazon S3 bucket 来托管一个 web application。  
这名 SysOps 管理员已经创建了 S3 bucket 并且已经复制了 web application 的静态文件到 S3 bucket。  
这家公司有一项政策，所有的 $3 buckets 必须不能是 public。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分发。配置 S3 桶作为源，带有一个源访问身份（OAI）。给予 OAI 在 S3 桶策略中 s3:GetObject 的权限。
B_zh: 在 S3 bucket 中配置静态网站托管。使用 Amazon Route 53 创建一个 DNS CNAME 指向 S3 网站端点。
C_zh: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将协议在 ALB 监听器配置中更改为 HTTPS。将流量转发到 S3 bucket。
D_zh: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个加速器。设置监听器配置以端口 443。将端点类型设置为将流量转发到 S3 bucket。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员 需要 配置 一个 Amazon S3 bucket 来 托管 一个 web application 。  
这名 SysOps 管理员 已经 创建 了 S3 bucket 并且 已经 复制 了 web application 的 静态文件 到 S3 bucket 。  
这家公司 有 一项 政策 ， 所有 的 $3 buckets 必须 不能 是 public 。  
SysOps 管理员 应该 做 什么 以 满足 这些 要求 ？

question: A company is building a web application on AWS. The company is using Amazon CloudFront with a domain name of www.example.com. All traffic to CloudFront must be encrypted in transit. The company already has provisioned an SSL certificate for www.example.com in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).  Which combination of steps should a SysOps administrator take to encrypt the traffic in transit? (Choose two.)
A: For each cache behavior in the CloudFront distribution, modify the Viewer Protocol Policy setting to redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
B: For each cache behavior in the CloudFront distribution, modify the Viewer Protocol Policy setting to allow HTTP and HTTPS.
C: Enter the alternate domain name (CNAME) of www.example.com for the CloudFront distribution. Select the custom SSL certificate.
D: Configure an AWS WAF web ACL for the CloudFront distribution.
E: Configure CloudFront Origin Shield for the CloudFront origin.
question_zh:
一家公司正在AWS上构建一个Web应用程序。  
The company is using Amazon CloudFront with a domain name of www.example.com.  
所有到CloudFront的流量都必须在传输中加密。

该公司已经在AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)中为www.example.com预配了一个SSL证书。

SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合以在传输中加密流量？（选择两个。）  
Which combination of steps should a SysOps administrator take to encrypt the traffic in transit? (Choose two.)

B_zh: 对于每个 cache behavior 在 CloudFront distribution 中，修改 Viewer Protocol Policy 设置以允许 HTTP 和 HTTPS。
C_zh: 输入 CloudFront 分发的 www.example.com 的备用域名（CNAME）。 选择自定义 SSL 证书。
D_zh: 为 CloudFront 分发配置一个 AWS WAF web ACL。
E_zh: 为 CloudFront 源配置 CloudFront Origin Shield。

所有到CloudFront的流量都必须在传输中加密。

question: A company runs an application on hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances in three Availability Zones. The application calls a third-party API over the public internet. A SysOps administrator must provide the third party with a list of static IP addresses so that the third party can allow traffic from the application.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Add a NAT gateway in the public subnet of each Availability Zone. Make the NAT gateway the default route of all private subnets in those Availability Zones.
B: Allocate one Elastic IP address in each Availability Zone. Associate the Elastic IP address with all the instances in the Availability Zone.
C: Place the instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Send the traffic to the internet through the private IP address of the NLB.
D: Update the main route table to send the traffic to the internet through an Elastic IP address that is assigned to each instance.
question_zh:

该应用程序通过公共互联网调用第三方 API。

question: A company manages its multi-account environment by using AWS Organizations. question: A company hosts a Windows-based file server on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The current setup does not allow application servers to access files simultaneously from the EC2 fleet.  Which solution will allow this access in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Multi-AZ file system. Copy the files to the EFS file system. Connect the EFS file system to mount points on the application servers.
B: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ file system. Copy the files to the Amazon FSx file system. Adjust the connections from the application servers to use the share that the Amazon FSx file system exposes.
C: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has EBS Multi-Attach enabled. Create an Auto Scaling group for the Windows file server. Use a script in the file server's user data to attach the SharedFileAccess tag to the EBS volume during launch.
D: Create two Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file systems. Configure Distributed File System (DFS) replication between the file systems. Copy the files to the Amazon FSx file systems. Adjust the connections from the application servers to use the shares that the Amazon FSx file systems expose.

question: A company hosts an internal application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances are in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group. Employees use the application to provide product prices to potential customers. The Auto Scaling group is configured with a dynamic scaling policy and tracks average CPU utilization of the instances.  Employees have noticed that sometimes the application becomes slow or unresponsive. A SysOps administrator finds that some instances are experiencing a high CPU load. The Auto Scaling group cannot scale out because the company is reaching the EC2 instance service quota.  The SysOps administrator needs to implement a solution that provides a notification when the company reaches 70% or more of the EC2 instance service quota.  Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient manner?
A: Create an AWS Lambda function that lists the EC2 instances, counts the EC2 instances, and compares the total number against the applied quota value by using the Service Quotas API. Configure the Lambda function to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification if the quota utilization is equal to or greater than 70%. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function.
B: Create an AWS Lambda function that lists the EC2 instances, counts the EC2 instances, and compares the total number against the applied quota value by using the Amazon CloudWatch Metrics API. Configure the Lambda function to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification if the quota utilization is equal to or greater than 70%. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function.
C: Use the Service Quotas console to create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the EC2 instances. Configure the alarm with quota utilization equal to or greater than 70%. Configure the alarm to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when the alarm enters ALARM state.
D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Configure the alarm with a threshold of 70% for the CPUUtilization metric for the EC2 instances. Configure the alarm to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when the alarm enters ALARM state.

question: A SysOps administrator must analyze Amazon CloudWatch logs across 10 AWS Lambda functions for historical errors. The logs are in JSON format and are stored in Amazon S3. What is the MOST operationally efficient way for the SysOps administrator to analyze the log files?

question: A company has a policy that all Amazon EC2 instance logs must be published to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. A SysOps administrator is troubleshooting an EC2 instance that is running Amazon Linux 2. The EC2 instance is not publishing logs to CloudWatch Logs. The Amazon CloudWatch agent is running on the EC2 instance, and the agent configuration file is correct.  What should the SysOps administrator do to resolve the issue?
A: Configure the AWS CLI on the EC2 instance. Create a cron job that calls the PutLogEvents API operation to push the log files to CloudWatch every 5 minutes.
B: Inspect the retention period of the CloudWatch Logs log group. Ensure that the retention period is set to a value that is greater than 1 day.
C: Set up an Amazon Kinesis data stream that is running in the same AWS Region as the EC2 instance. Configure the CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instance to send CloudWatch events to the data stream.
D: Ensure that the IAM role that is attached to the EC2 instance has permissions in CloudWatch Logs for the CreateLogGroup, CreateLogStream, PutLogEvents, and DescribeLogStreams actions.
question_zh: 一家公司有一项政策，所有 Amazon EC2 实例日志必须发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。 一名 SysOps 管理员正在排查一台运行 Amazon Linux 2 的 EC2 实例。 这台 EC2 实例没有将日志发布到 CloudWatch Logs。 Amazon CloudWatch agent 正在 EC2 实例上运行，且 agent 配置文件是正确的。  管理员应该做什么以解决这个问题？

B_zh: 检查 CloudWatch Logs 日志组的保留期。确保保留期设置为大于 1 天的值。
C_zh: 建立一个 Amazon Kinesis data stream，该数据流在与 EC2 实例相同的 AWS Region 中运行。配置在 EC2 实例上的 CloudWatch agent，以将 CloudWatch 事件发送到该数据流。
D_zh: 确保附加到 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色在 CloudWatch Logs 中具有 CreateLogGroup、CreateLogStream、PutLogEvents 和 DescribeLogStreams 操作的权限。

question: A company runs a workload on an Amazon EC2 instance. The workload needs a temporary cache that contains data that changes frequently. The workload does not need to retain the cache across instance restarts.  Which storage option will provide the HIGHEST performance for the cache?

B: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume

question_zh:

该工作负载需要一个包含频繁变化数据的临时缓存。  
该工作负载不需要在实例重启之间保留缓存。  
哪种存储选项将为缓存提供最高性能？

question: A company runs multiple workloads across an organization in AWS Organizations. The company's finance team needs detailed dashboards to track cost changes and provide detailed cost metrics. The finance team needs to track trends as granular as every hour.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A: Generate Amazon CloudWatch dashboards by using CloudWatch insights and AWS Cost Explorer data.
B: Generate an AWS Cost and Usage Report. Store the report in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to develop dashbosrds based on the data in the AWS Cost and Usage Report.
C: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs once a day and assumes a role in every account in the organization. Configure the Lambda function to read AWS Cost Explorer data in each account and to store the cost data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to display the data in dashboards.
D: Create an IAM user for the finance team. Grant permissions to the IAM user to view AWS Cost Explorer data and billing data in the management account.
question_zh: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中跨组织运行多个工作负载。 公司的财务团队需要详细的仪表板来跟踪成本变化并提供详细的成本指标。 财务团队需要跟踪每小时的趋势。  SysOps 管理员应该做什么以以最具操作效率的方式满足这些需求？

B_zh: 生成一个 AWS Cost and Usage Report。将报告存储在 Amazon S3。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 根据 AWS Cost and Usage Report 中的数据开发仪表板。
C_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数每天运行一次，并在组织中的每个账户中假设一个角色。配置该 Lambda 函数以读取每个账户中的 AWS Cost Explorer 数据，并将成本数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon Athena 来查询数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 在仪表板中显示数据。

question: A company has a core application that must run 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The application uses Amazon EC2. AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda. The company needs to maximize cost savings while committing to a pricing model that offers flexibility to make changes.  What should the company do to meet these requirements?
A: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan that is based on Savings Plans recommendations
B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan that covers the EC2 instance types and the Fargate and Lambda vCPU equivalents.
C: Purchase a Reserved Instance for the instance types, operating systems, Region, and tenancy,

question: A company's architecture team must receive immediate email notification whenever new Amazon EC2 instances are launched in the company's main AWS production account.  'What should a SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Create a user data script that sends an email message through a smart host connector. Include the architecture team's email address in the user data script as the recipient. Ensure that all new EC2 instances include the user data script as part of a standardized build process.
B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and a subscription that uses the email protocol. Enter the architecture team's email address as the subscriber. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when EC2 instances are launched. Specify the SNS topic as the rule's target.
C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and a subscription that uses the email protocol. Enter the architecture team's email address as the subscriber. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when EC2 instances are launched. Specify the SQS queue as the rule's target.
D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure AWS Systems Manager to publish EC2 events to the SNS topic. Create an AWS Lambda function to poll the SNS topic. Configure the Lambda function to send any messages to the architecture team's email address.
question_zh: 一家公司'的架构团队必须在公司'的主要 AWS 生产账户中每当新 Amazon EC2 实例被启动时立即收到电子邮件通知。 'SysOps 管理员应该做什么以满足这个要求？
A_zh: 创建一个用户数据脚本，该脚本通过 smart host connector 发送电子邮件消息。包括架构团队的电子邮件地址在用户数据脚本中作为收件人。确保所有新的 EC2 实例都包含用户数据脚本，作为标准化构建过程的一部分。

D_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。配置 AWS Systems Manager 以将 EC2 事件发布到 SNS 主题。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数以轮询 SNS 主题。配置 Lambda 函数将任何消息发送到架构团队的电子邮件地址。

question: A SysOps administrator manages an AWS account where developers run CPU-intensive tasks on Amazon EC2 instances. The tasks can take several days to finish running and sometimes need to be repeated several times. The developers often forget to terminate the instances when the tasks are complete.  The SysOps administrator needs to implement a solution to monitor EC2 CPU utilization and automatically terminate underutilized instances.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Configure an Amazon GuardDuty finding that is based on EC2 CPU utilization. Associate an AWS Lambda function with the GuardDuty finding to terminate any instances that are identified as idle.
B: Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive EC2 utilization messages from the AWS Health Dashboard. Create an AWS Lambda function. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Use the ec2.stop_instances operation to terminate idle instances.
C: Configure a Low Utilization Amazon EC2 Instances check in AWS Trusted Advisor to publish status changes to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Use the ec2.stop_instances operation to terminate idle instances.
D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule for the Low Utilization Amazon EC2 Instances check in AWS Trusted Advisor. Select the EC2 Terminatelnstances API call as the target.
question_zh:

开发人员经常忘记在任务完成后终止实例。  
SysOps 管理员需要实施一个解决方案，以监控 EC2 CPU 利用率并自动终止利用率低的实例。

B_zh: 配置一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题以接收来自 AWS Health Dashboard 的 EC2 利用率消息。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。订阅该 Lambda 函数到 SNS 主题。使用 ec2.stop_instances 操作以终止空闲实例。
C_zh:
在 AWS Trusted Advisor 中配置一个低利用率的 Amazon EC2 Instances 检查，以发布状态变化到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。  
创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。  
将 Lambda 函数订阅到 SNS 主题。  
使用 ec2.stop_instances 操作来终止空闲的实例。
