为 AWS Trusted Advisor 中的 Low Utilization Amazon EC2 Instances 检查配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则。  
选择 EC2 TerminateInstances API 调用作为目标。

与业务单位共享一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板。

在 CloudFormation 模板中创建一个 AWS::SecretsManager::Secret 资源。  
通过使用 resolve:ssm-secure 动态引用，在 AWS::RDS::DBInstance 资源中引用凭证。

在 CloudFormation 模板中创建一个 AWS::SSM::Parameter 资源。  
通过使用 resolve:ssm 动态引用，引用 AWS::RDS::DBInstance 资源中的凭证。

question: A company hosts a production database on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) backed Amazon EC2 instance. A: Enable EBS fast snapshot restore (FSR) on the snapshots for the second Availability Zone. Create new EBS volumes in the second Availability Zone from the snapshots. Attach the new EBS volumes to a new EC2 instance.

D: Specify Provisioned IOPS on the existing EBS volumes. Create the snapshots. After the snapshots are completed, create new EBS volumes in the second Availability Zone from the snapshots. Attach the new EBS volumes to a new EC2 instance.

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its multi-account environment. The organization contains a dedicated account for security and a dedicated account for logging. A SysOps administrator needs to implement a centralized solution that provides alerts when a resource metric in any account crosses a standard defined threshold.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Deploy an AWS CloudFormation stack set to the accounts in the organization. Use a template that creates the required Amazon CloudWatch alarms and references an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic in the logging account with publish permissions for all the accounts.
B: Deploy an AWS CloudFormation stack in each account. Use the stack to deploy the required Amazon CloudWalch alarms and the required Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
C: Deploy an AWS Lambda function on a cron job in each account. Configure the Lambda function to read resources that are in the account and to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if any metrics cross the defined threshold.
D: Deploy an AWS CloudFormation change set to the organization. Use a template to create the required Amazon CloudWatch alarms and to send alerts to a verified Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) identity.
question_zh:
一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 来管理其多账户环境。  
该组织包含一个用于安全的专用账户和一个用于日志记录的专用账户。  
一名 SysOps 管理员需要实现一个集中式解决方案，提供当任何账户中的资源指标超过定义的标准阈值时的警报。  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

在组织中的账户部署一个 AWS CloudFormation stack set。  
使用一个模板，该模板创建所需的 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，并在日志账户中引用一个具有发布权限的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，供所有账户使用。
B_zh:
在每个账户中部署一个 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈。  
使用该堆栈部署所需的 Amazon CloudWatch 警报和所需的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。
C_zh:
在每个账户中部署一个 AWS Lambda 函数在一个 cron 任务上。  
配置该 Lambda 函数以读取在该账户中的资源，并且调用一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题如果任何指标超过定义的阈值。
D_zh: 将 AWS CloudFormation 变更集部署到组织中。使用模板创建所需的 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，并将警报发送到已验证的 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 身份。

question: A company has an application that uses a scheduled AWS Lambda function to retrieve datasets from external sources over the internet. The function is not associated with a VPC. The company is modifying the application to store the information that the Lambda function retrieves on an Amazon RDS DB instance in a private subnet. The VPC has two public subnets and two private subnets.  A SysOps administrator must deploy a solution that allows the Lambda function to access the new database and continue to access the internet.  Which solution meets these requirements?
A: Create a new Lambda function with VPC access and an Elastic IP address. Attach the function to public subnets in two Availability Zones. Associate a security group with the Elastic IP address. Configure the security group outbound rules to allow Lambda to access the required resources.
B: Create a new Lambda function with VPC access and two public IP addresses. Attach the function to public subnets in the same Availability Zones that the database uses. Associate a security group with the function. Configure the security group inbound rules to allow Lambda to access the required resources.
C: Reconfigure the Lambda function for VPC access. Add NAT gateways to the public subnets in the VPAdd route table entries in the private subnets to route through the NAT gateways to the internet. Attach the function to the private subnets that support the database. Associate a security group with the function. Configure the security group outbound rules to allow Lambda to access the internet.
D: Reconfigure the Lambda function for VPC access. Attach the function to the private subnets. Add route table entries in the private subnets to route through the internet gateway to the internet. Associate a security group with the subnets. Configure the security group inbound rules to allow Lambda to access the required resources through the internet gateway.
question_zh:

该函数没有与 VPC 相关联。  
该公司正在修改应用程序，以在一个 Amazon RDS DB 实例的私有子网中存储 Lambda 函数检索到的信息。  
该 VPC 有两个公共子网和两个私有子网。

哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

创建一个具有 VPC 访问权限和 Elastic IP 地址的新 Lambda 函数。  
将该函数附加到两个可用区中的公共子网。  
将安全组与 Elastic IP 地址关联。  
配置安全组的出站规则以允许 Lambda 访问所需的资源。
B_zh:
创建一个具有 VPC 访问权限和两个公共 IP 地址的新 Lambda 函数。  
将该函数附加到与数据库使用的相同可用区中的公共子网。

D_zh: 重新配置 Lambda 函数以实现 VPC 访问。将该函数附加到私有子网。在私有子网中添加路由表条目，通过 internet gateway 路由到 internet。将安全组与子网关联。配置安全组的入站规则，以允许 Lambda 通过 internet gateway 访问所需的资源。

使用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 每小时对 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷进行快照。  
在 EC2 实例故障的情况下，从快照恢复 EBS 卷。

question: A company uses AWS CloudFormation to manage a stack of Amazon EC2 instances on AWS. A SysOps administrator needs to keep the instances and all of the instances' data, even if someone deletes the stack.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Set the DeletionPolicy attribute to Snapshot for the EC2 instance resource in the CloudFormation template.
B: Automate backups by using Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM).
C: Create a backup plan in AWS Backup.

question: Accompany wants to monitor the number of Amazon EC2 instances that it is running. The company also wants to automate a service quota increase when the number of instances reaches a specific threshold.  Which solution meets these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor Service Quotas. Configure the alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function to request a quota increase when the alarm reaches the threshold.
B: Create an AWS Config rule to monitor Service Quotas. Call an AWS Lambda function to remediate the action and increase the quota.
C: Create an Amazon CloudWateh alarm to monitor the AWS Health Dashboard. Configure the alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function to request a quota increase when the alarm reaches the threshold.
D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor AWS Trusted Advisor service quotas. Configure the alarm to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to increase the quota.

该 公司 也 想要 自动化 一个 服务 配额 增加 当 实例 数量 达到 一个 特定 阈值 时。  
哪 一个 解决方案 满足 这些 要求？

创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控 AWS Trusted Advisor 服务配额。  
配置该警报以向一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发布消息以增加配额。

question: A SysOps administrator is responsible for more than 50 Amazon EC2 instances that are deployed in a single production AWS account. The EC2 instances are running several different operating systems. The company's standards require patching to be completed at least once a month.  The SysOps administrator wants to use AWS Systems Manager to reduce the number of hours the company spends on operating system patching each month. question: ASysOps administrator configures an application to run on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a simple scaling Auto Scaling group with the default settings. The Auto Scaling group is configured to use the RequestCountPerTarget metric for scaling. The SysOps administrator notices that the RequestCountPerTarget metric exceeded the specified limit twice in 180 seconds.  How will the number of EC2 instances in this Auto Scaling group be affected in this scenario?
A: The Auto Scaling group will launch an additional EC2 instance every time the RequestCountPerTarget metric exceeds the predefined limit.
B: The Auto Scaling group will launch one EC2 instance and will wait for the default cooldown period before launching another instance.
C: The Auto Scaling group will send an alert to the ALB to rebalance the traffic and not add new EC2 instances until the load is normalized.
D: The Auto Scaling group will try to distribute the traffic among all EC2 instances before launching another instance.
question_zh:
SysOps 管理员配置一个应用程序在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行，位于一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面，使用一个具有默认设置的简单扩展 Auto Scaling 组。  
该 Auto Scaling 组被配置为使用 RequestCountPerTarget 指标进行扩展。  
SysOps 管理员注意到 RequestCountPerTarget 指标在 180 秒内超过了指定的限制两次。  
在这种情况下，这个 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例数量将受到怎样的影响？
A_zh: Auto Scaling 组将每次当 RequestCountPerTarget 指标超过预定义限制时，启动一个额外的 EC2 实例。
B_zh: Auto Scaling 组将启动一个 EC2 实例，并且将等待默认冷却时间，然后再启动另一个实例。

question: A company has a secure website running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). An SSL certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) is used on the ALB. A: Enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) in the MySQL configuration file. Manually rotate the key every 12 months.
B: Enable RDS encryption on the database at creation time by using the AWS managed key for Amazon RDS.
C: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Enable RDS encryption on the database at creation time by using the KMS key.
D: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Enable encryption on the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to the RDS DB instance.
question_zh:
一家公司需要在 AWS 上部署一个新的工作负载。  
The company 必须加密所有静态数据，并且必须每年轮换一次加密密钥。

question: A company runs a high performance computing (HPC) application on an Amazon EC2 instance. The company needs to scale this architecture to two or more EC2 instances. The EC2 instances will need to communicate with each other at high speeds with low latency to support the application.  The company wants to ensure that the network performance can support the required communication between the EC2 instances  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?
A: Create a cluster placement group. Back up the existing EC2 instance to an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Restore the EC2 instance from the AMI into the placement group. Launch the additional EC2 instances into the placement group.
B: Back up the existing EC2 instance to an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Create a launch template from the existing EC2 instance by specifying the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group and configure the desired instance count.
C: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and a target group. Launch the new EC2 instances and register them with the target group. Register the existing EC2 instance with the target group. Pass all application traffic through the NLB.
D: Back up the existing EC2 instance to an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Create additional clones of the EC2 instance from the AMI in the same Availability Zone where the existing EC2 instance is located.

这些 EC2 实例将需要以高速、低延迟相互通信，以支持该应用程序。  
该公司希望确保网络性能能够支持 EC2 实例之间所需的通信。

将现有的 EC2 实例备份到一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。

question: A developer creates an AWS Lambda function that runs when an object is put into an Amazon S3 bucket. The function reformats the object and places the object back into the S3 bucket. What should the SysOps administrator do to stop the loop without errors?

question_zh:

question: A company stores files on 50 Amazon S3 buckets in the same AWS Region. The company wants to connect to the S3 buckets securely over a private connection from its Amazon EC2 instances. question: A company's security policy states that connecting to Amazon EC2 instances is not permitted through SSH and ROP. What should a SysOps administrator do to resolve this issue?

question: A SysOps administrator is configuring Amazon CloudWatch alarms. A particular is constantly in the ALARM state.  What could be the reason for this issue?

一个特定的持续处于 ALARM 状态。

question: A company has set up an IPsec tunnel between its AWS environment and its on-premises data center. The tunnel is reporting as UP, but the Amazon EC2 instances are not able to ping any on-premises resources.  What should a SysOps administrator do to resolve this issue?
A: Create a new inbound rule on the EC2 instances' security groups to allow ICMP traffic from the on-premises CIDR.
B: Create a peering connection between the IPsec tunnel and the subnet of the EC2 instances.
C: Enable route propagation for the virtual private gateway in the route table that is assigned to the subnet of the EC2 instances.

如果端口被打开，公司需要尽快关闭该端口。

question: A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group. Scale-out 操作需要很长时间才能完成，因为启动脚本运行时间长。

question: A company asks a SysOps administrator to provision an additional environment for an application in four additional AWS Regions. The application is running on more than 100 Amazon C2 instances in the us-east-1 Region, using fully configured Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). The company has an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy resources in us-east-1.  What should the SysOps administrator do to provision the application in the MOST operationally efficient manner?
A: Copy the AMI to each Region by using the aws ec2 copy-image command. Update the CloudFormation template to include mappings for the copied AMIs.
B: Create a snapshot of the running instance. Copy the snapshot to the other Regions. Create an AMI from the snapshots. Update the CloudFormation template for each Region to use the new AMI.
C: Run the existing CloudFormation template in each additional Region based on the success of the template that is used currently in us-east-1.

question_zh:
一家公司要求一名 SysOps 管理员在另外四个 AWS Regions 中为一个应用程序配置一个额外的环境。

question: A company runs its applications on a large number of Amazon EC2 instances. A SysOps administrator must implement a solution to notify the operations team whenever an EC2 instance state changes.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create a script that captures instance state changes and publishes a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on all EC2 instances.
B: Create an Amazon EventBridge event rule that captures EC2 instance state changes. Set an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the target
C: Create an Amazon EventBridge event rule that captures EC2 instance state changes. Set as the target an AWS Lambda function that publishes a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
D: Create an AWS Config custom rule that evaluates instance state changes with automatic remediation. Use the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
question_zh: 一家公司在大量的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其应用程序。 一名 SysOps 管理员必须实现一个解决方案，以在 EC2 实例状态更改时通知运营团队。 什么是满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案？
A_zh: 创建一个脚本，捕获实例状态变化，并发布通知到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 在所有 EC2 实例上运行该脚本。
B_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件规则，该规则捕获 EC2 实例状态变化。设置一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题作为目标
C_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件规则，该规则捕获 EC2 实例状态变化。设置作为目标的 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发布通知。
D_zh: 创建一个 AWS Config 自定义规则，该规则评估实例状态变化与自动修复。使用该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数向一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发布通知。

question: A company has migrated its legacy on-premises web application to an Amazon EC2 instance. The web application requires a single static public IP address to accept traffic and process requests. End users must be able to reach the web application through the example.com domain. A SysOps administrator must implement a solution that maintains the web application with the least amount of effort.  Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
A: Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Add the EC2 instance to a target group that is associated with the ALB.
B: Create an Amazon Route 53 A record for the associated EC2 IP address.
C: Create an Amazon Route 53 CNAME record for the associated EC2 IP address.
D: Create an Elastic IP address, and associate it with the EC2 instance.
E: Create an Auto Scaling group with a minimum capacity of 1 and a maximum capacity of 2.
question_zh:
一家公司已经将其遗留的本地 web 应用程序迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。  
The web application 需要一个单一的静态公共 IP 地址以接受流量并处理请求。  
End users 必须能够通过 example.com 域名访问 web 应用程序。  
A SysOps administrator 必须实施一个解决方案，以最少的努力维护 web 应用程序。  
Which combination of actions 将满足这些要求？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。添加 EC2 实例到一个目标组，该目标组与 ALB 相关联。
B_zh: 为相关联的 EC2 IP 地址创建一个 Amazon Route 53 A 记录。
C_zh: 为关联的 EC2 IP 地址创建一个 Amazon Route 53 CNAME 记录。
D_zh: 创建 一个 Elastic IP 地址 ， 并 将 它 与 EC2 实例 关联 。
E_zh: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，具有最小容量为 1 和最大容量为 2。

question: A company is using an Amazon DynamoDB table for data. A SysOps administrator must configure replication of the table to another AWS Region for disaster recovery.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?

B: Enable DynamoDB Streams, and add a global secondary index (GSI).
C: Enable DynamoDB Streams, and add a global table Region.

question: A company has an existing public web application for www.example.com. The Application Load Balancer (ALB) is configured with a single HTTP 80 listener. A SysOps administrator must ensure that all web requests to www.example.com are encrypted between the client and the ALB.  The SysOps administrator already has requested and validated a public certificate for www.example.com in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Existing users of the application must not be required to change the endpoint to which they are connecting.  Which additional set of steps should the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements?
A: Create an additional ALB listener for HTTPS on port 443. Set the default action to forward all traffic to the target group. Specify the ACM certificate that was created for www.example.com as the default SSL certificate.
B: Create an additional ALB listener for HTTPS on port 443. Set the default action to forward all traffic to the target group. Specify the ACM certificate that was created for www.example.com as the default SSL certificate. Delete the original HTTP listener on port 80.
C: Modify the ALB default rule for the HTTP port 80 listener. Create a rule in the listener to forward all traffic for the host www example.com to the target group. Specify the ACM certificate that was created for www.example.com as the default SSL certificate.
D: Modify the ALB default rule for the HTTP port 80 listener to redirect to HTTPS on port 443. Create an additional HTTPS listener on port 443. Set the default action to forward all traffic to the target group. Specify the ACM certificate that was created for www example.com as the default SSL certificate.
question_zh:
一家公司拥有一个现有的公共网页应用程序用于 www.example.com。  
The Application Load Balancer (ALB) 被配置有一个单一的 HTTP 80 监听器。  
一名 SysOps 管理员必须确保所有对 www.example.com 的网页请求在客户端和 ALB 之间都是加密的。  
SysOps 管理员已经请求并验证了一个用于 www.example.com 的公共证书在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中。  
应用程序的现有用户不必被要求更改他们连接的端点。  
应采取哪一组额外的步骤以满足这些要求？
A_zh:
为 HTTPS 在端口 443 创建一个额外的 ALB 监听器。  
将默认操作设置为将所有流量转发到目标组。  
指定为 www.example.com 创建的 ACM 证书作为默认的 SSL 证书。
B_zh:
为 HTTPS 在端口 443 创建一个额外的 ALB 监听器。  
将默认操作设置为将所有流量转发到目标组。  
指定为 www.example.com 创建的 ACM 证书作为默认的 SSL 证书。  
删除端口 80 上的原始 HTTP 监听器。
C_zh:
修改 ALB 默认规则 用于 HTTP 端口 80 监听器。  
在 监听器 中 创建 一条 规则 以 转发 所有 流量 给 主机 www example.com 到 目标组。  
指定 ACM 证书 那个 为 创建 用于 www.example.com 作为 默认 SSL 证书。
D_zh: 修改 ALB 默认规则 用于 HTTP 端口 80 监听器 到 重定向 到 HTTPS 在 端口 443。 创建 一个 额外的 HTTPS 监听器 在 端口 443。 设置 默认 操作为 转发 所有 流量 到 目标组。 指定 ACM 证书 那个 被 创建 用于 www example.com 作为 默认 SSL 证书。

question: A manufacturing company uses an Amazon RDS DB instance to store inventory of all stock items. The company maintains several AWS Lambda functions that interact with the database to add, update, and delete items. The Lambda functions use hardcoded credentials to connect to the database.  A SysOps administrator must ensure that the database credentials are never stored in plaintext and that the password is rotated every 30 days.  Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient manner?
A: Store the database password as an environment variable for each Lambda function. Create a new Lambda function that is named PasswordRotate. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule the PasswordRotate function every 30 days to change the database password and update the environment variable for each Lambda function.
B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the database password and to store the encrypted password as an environment variable for each Lambda function. Grant each Lambda function access to the KMS key so that the database password can be decrypted when required. Create a new Lambda function that is named PasswordRotate to change the password every 30 days.
C: Use AWS Secrets Manager to store credentials for the database. Create a Secrets Manager secret, and select the database so that Secrets Manager will use a Lambda function to update the database password automatically. Specify an automatic rotation schedule of 30 days. Update each Lambda function to access the database password from Secrets Manager.
D: Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to create a secure string to store credentials for the database. Create a new Lambda function called PasswordRotate. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule the PasswordRotate function every 30 days to change the database password and to update the secret within Parameter Store. Update each Lambda function to access the database password from Parameter Store.
question_zh:
一家制造公司使用 Amazon RDS DB 实例来存储所有库存项目的库存。  
The company maintains several AWS Lambda functions that interact with the database to add, update, and delete items.  
该公司维护多个 AWS Lambda 函数，这些函数与数据库交互以添加、更新和删除项目。  
The Lambda functions use hardcoded credentials to connect to the database.  
这些 Lambda 函数使用硬编码的凭证连接到数据库。  
A SysOps administrator must ensure that the database credentials are never stored in plaintext and that the password is rotated every 30 days.  
一名 SysOps 管理员必须确保数据库凭证永远不以明文存储，并且密码每30天轮换一次。  
Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient manner?  
哪种解决方案将以最具操作效率的方式满足这些要求？
A_zh: 将数据库密码作为环境变量存储在每个 Lambda 函数中。创建一个名为 PasswordRotate 的新 Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon EventBridge 来安排 PasswordRotate 函数每 30 天更改一次数据库密码，并更新每个 Lambda 函数的环境变量。
B_zh: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来加密数据库密码，并将加密后的密码作为环境变量存储在每个 Lambda 函数中。授予每个 Lambda 函数对 KMS 密钥的访问权限，以便在需要时可以解密数据库密码。创建一个名为 PasswordRotate 的新 Lambda 函数，用于每 30 天更改一次密码。
C_zh: 使用 AWS Secrets Manager 来存储数据库的凭证。创建一个 Secrets Manager 密钥，并选择数据库，以便 Secrets Manager 将使用 Lambda 函数自动更新数据库密码。指定一个自动轮换计划为 30 天。更新每个 Lambda 函数，以便从 Secrets Manager 访问数据库密码。
D_zh: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 创建一个安全字符串，用于存储数据库的凭证。创建一个名为 PasswordRotate 的新 Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon EventBridge 来安排 PasswordRotate 函数每 30 天一次，以更改数据库密码并更新 Parameter Store 中的秘密。更新每个 Lambda 函数，以便从 Parameter Store 访问数据库密码。

question: A developer creates a web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The developer reviews the deployment and notices some suspicious traffic to the application. The traffic is malicious and is coming from a single public IP address. A SysOps administrator must block the public IP address.  Which solution will meet this requirement?

question: A company's SysOps administrator manages a fleet of hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that run Windows-based workloads and Linux-based workloads. The SysOps administrator needs to implement the code on the EC2 instances and must provide a report that shows that the code has successfully run on all the instances.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements as quickly as possible?
A: Use Systems Manager Run Command. Choose either the AWS-RunShellScript document or the AWS-RunPowerShellScript document. Configure Run Command with the code from the security team. Specify the operating system tag in the Targets parameter. Run the command. Provide the command history's evidence to the security team.
B: Create an AWS Lambda function that connects to the EC2 instances through Session Manager. Configure the Lambda function to identify the operating system, run the code from the security team, and return the results to an Amazon RDS DB instance. Query the DB instance for the results. Provide the results as evidence to the security team.
C: Log on to each EC2 instance. Run the code from the security team on each EC2 instance. Copy and paste the results of each run into a single spreadsheet. Provide the spreadsheet as evidence to the security team.
D: Update the launch templates of the EC2 instances to include the code from the security team in the user data. Relaunch the EC2 instances by using the updated launch templates. Retrieve the EC2 instance logs of each instance. Provide the EC2 instance logs as evidence to the security team.

question: A SysOps administrator notices that the cache hit ratio for an Amazon CloudFront distribution is less than 10%. Which combination of actions should the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
A: Enable CloudFront Origin Shield for the required AWS Regions.
B: Change the viewer protocol policy to use HTTPS only.
C: Add a second origin. Create an origin group that includes both origins. Activate CloudFront origin failover.
D: Turn on automatic compression of objects in the cache behavior settings.
E: Increase the CloudFront TTL values in the cache behavior settings.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员注意到，Amazon CloudFront 分发的缓存命中率低于 10%。  
The SysOps administrator needs to increase the cache hit ratio for the distribution, improve network performance, and reduce the load on the origin.  
SysOps 管理员需要提高分发的缓存命中率，改善网络性能，并减少对 origin 的负载。  
Which combination of actions should the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)  
应采取哪两项行动组合以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 为所需的 AWS 区域启用 CloudFront Origin Shield。
B_zh: 将 viewer protocol policy 改为 使用 HTTPS only。
C_zh: 添加第二个源。创建一个包含两个源的源组。激活 CloudFront 源故障转移。
D_zh: 在缓存行为设置中开启对象的自动压缩。
E_zh: 在 cache behavior 设置中增加 CloudFront TTL 值。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员注意到，Amazon CloudFront 分发的缓存命中率低于 10%。  
The SysOps administrator needs to increase the cache hit ratio for the distribution, improve network performance, and reduce the load on the origin.  
SysOps 管理员需要提高分发的缓存命中率，改善网络性能，并减少对 origin 的负载。  
Which combination of actions should the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)  
应采取哪两项行动组合以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

question: A custom application must be installed on all Amazon EC2 instances. The application is small, updated frequently, and can be installed automatically.  How can the application be deployed on new EC2 instances?
A: Launch a script that downloads and installs the application using Amazon EC2 user data.
B: Create a custom API using Amazon API Gateway to call an installation executable from an AWS CloudFormation template.
C: Use AWS Systems Manager to inject the application into an AMI.
D: Configure AWS CodePipeline to deploy code changes and updates.
question_zh:
必须在所有 Amazon EC2 实例上安装一个自定义应用程序。  
该应用程序很小，更新频繁，并且可以自动安装。  
如何在新的 EC2 实例上部署该应用程序？
A_zh: 启动 一个 脚本 ， 它 下载 并 安装 应用程序 使用 Amazon EC2 用户数据 。
B_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 创建一个自定义 API，以从 AWS CloudFormation 模板调用安装可执行文件。
C_zh: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 将应用程序注入到一个 AMI。
D_zh: 配置 AWS CodePipeline 以部署 代码 变更 和 更新。
question_zh_zh:
必须在所有 Amazon EC2 实例上安装一个自定义应用程序。  
该应用程序很小，更新频繁，并且可以自动安装。  
如何在新的 EC2 实例上部署该应用程序？

question: A SysOps administrator wants to securely share an object from a private Amazon S3 bucket with a group of users who do not have an AWS account.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that will meet this requirement?
A: Attach an S3 bucket policy that only allows object downloads from the users' IP addresses.
B: Create an IAM role that has access to the object. Instruct the users to assume the role.
C: Create an IAM user that has access to the object. Share the credentials with the users.
D: Generate a presigned URL for the object. Share the URL with the users.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员想要安全地与没有 AWS 账户的一组用户共享来自私有 Amazon S3 bucket 的对象。  
什么是最具操作效率的解决方案，能够满足这个需求？
A_zh: 附加一个 S3 bucket 政策，该政策只允许对象从用户的 IP 地址下载。
B_zh: 创建一个具有访问对象权限的 IAM 角色。指示用户假设该角色。
C_zh: 创建一个具有访问该对象权限的 IAM 用户。与用户共享凭证。
D_zh: 为对象生成一个 presigned URL。与用户分享该 URL。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员想要安全地与没有 AWS 账户的一组用户共享来自私有 Amazon S3 bucket 的对象。  
什么是最具操作效率的解决方案，能够满足这个需求？

question: A company is running an ecommerce application on AWS. The application maintains many open but idle connections to an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. During times of peak usage, the database produces the following error message: "Too many connections." The database clients are also experiencing errors.  Which solution will resolve these errors?
A: Increase the read capacity units (RCUs) and the write capacity units (WCUs) on the database.
B: Configure RDS Proxy. Update the application with the RDS Proxy endpoint.
C: Turn on enhanced networking for the DB instances.
D: Modify the DB cluster to use a burstable instance type.
question_zh: 一家公司正在AWS上运行一个电子商务应用程序。 该应用程序维护许多开放但空闲的连接到一个Amazon Aurora DB集群。 在高峰使用时，数据库产生以下错误信息： "Too many connections."。 数据库客户端也遇到错误。 哪个解决方案将解决这些错误？
A_zh: 增加 读容量单位（RCUs） 和 写容量单位（WCUs） 在 数据库 上。
B_zh: 配置 RDS Proxy。用 RDS Proxy 端点更新应用程序。
C_zh: 为数据库实例开启增强网络。
D_zh: 修改 该 数据库 集群 以 使用 一个 burstable 实例 类型。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司正在 AWS 上运行一个电子商务应用程序。  
The company is running an e-commerce application on AWS.  

该应用程序维护许多开放但空闲的连接到一个 Amazon Aurora DB 集群。  
The application maintains many open but idle connections to an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.  

在高峰使用时，数据库产生以下错误信息： "Too many connections."。  
During peak usage, the database produces the following error message: "Too many connections."。  

数据库客户端也遇到错误。  
The database clients also encounter errors.  

哪个解决方案将解决这些错误？  
Which solution will resolve these errors?

question: A SysOps administrator is troubleshooting a VPC with public and private subnets that leverage custom network ACLs. Instances in the private subnet are unable to access the internet. There is an internet gateway attached to the public subnet. The private subnet has a route to a NAT gateway that is also attached to the public subnet. The Amazon EC2 instances are associated with the default security group for the VPC.  What is causing the issue in this scenario?
A: There is a network ACL on the private subnet set to deny all outbound traffic.
B: There is no NAT gateway deployed in the private subnet of the VPC.
C: The default security group for the VPC blocks all inbound traffic to the EC2 instances.
D: The default security group for the VPC blocks all outbound traffic from the EC2 instances.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在排查一个具有公共子网和私有子网的 VPC， 这些子网利用自定义网络 ACLs。  
实例在私有子网中无法访问互联网。  
有一个 internet gateway 附加到公共子网。  
私有子网有一条路由到一个 NAT gateway，该 NAT gateway 也附加到公共子网。  
Amazon EC2 实例与 VPC 的默认安全组相关联。  
在这种情况下，导致问题的原因是什么？
A_zh: 在私有子网上有一个网络ACL，设置为拒绝所有出站流量。
B_zh: 在 VPC 的私有子网中，没有部署 NAT gateway。
C_zh: VPC 的默认安全组 阻止 所有 入站 流量 到 EC2 实例。
D_zh: VPC 的默认安全组 阻止 所有 出站 流量 从 EC2 实例。
question_zh_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员正在排查一个具有公共子网和私有子网的 VPC， 这些子网利用自定义网络 ACLs。  
实例在私有子网中无法访问互联网。  
有一个 internet gateway 附加到公共子网。  
私有子网有一条路由到一个 NAT gateway，该 NAT gateway 也附加到公共子网。  
Amazon EC2 实例与 VPC 的默认安全组相关联。  
在这种情况下，导致问题的原因是什么？

question: A company stores its internal data within an Amazon S3 bucket. All existing data within the S3 bucket is protected by using server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). S3 Versioning is enabled. A SysOps administrator must replicate the internal data to another S3 bucket in a different AWS account for disaster recovery. All the existing data is copied from the source S3 bucket to the destination S3 bucket.  Which replication solution is MOST operationally efficient?
A: Add a replication rule to the source bucket and specify the destination bucket. Create a bucket policy for the destination bucket to allow the owner of the source bucket to replicate objects.
B: Schedule an AWS Batch job with Amazon EventBridge to copy new objects from the source bucket to the destination bucket. Create a Batch Operations IAM role in the destination account.
C: Configure an Amazon S3 event notification for the source bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function to copy new objects to the destination bucket. Ensure that the Lambda function has cross-account access permissions.
D: Run a scheduled script on an Amazon EC2 instance to copy new objects from the source bucket to the destination bucket. Assign cross-account access permissions to the EC2 instance's role.
question_zh: 一家公司将其内部数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中。所有存在的 数据在 S3 bucket 内通过使用 server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) 进行保护。 S3 Versioning 已启用。 一个 SysOps 管理员必须将内部数据复制到另一个 S3 bucket 中，位于不同的 AWS 账户中，以进行灾难恢复。 所有现有的数据都从源 S3 bucket 复制到目标 S3 bucket。 哪种复制解决方案在操作上最有效率？
A_zh: 向源存储桶添加复制规则，并指定目标存储桶。为目标存储桶创建存储桶策略，以允许源存储桶的所有者复制对象。
B_zh: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 安排一个 AWS Batch 作业，以复制新对象从源存储桶到目标存储桶。 在目标账户中创建一个 Batch Operations IAM 角色。
C_zh:
为源存储桶配置一个 Amazon S3 事件通知，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将新对象复制到目标存储桶。  
确保 Lambda 函数具有跨账户访问权限。
D_zh:
在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个定时脚本，以将新对象从源存储桶复制到目标存储桶。  
为 EC2 实例的角色分配跨账户访问权限。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司将其内部数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中。  
所有存在的 数据在 S3 bucket 内通过使用 server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) 进行保护。  
S3 Versioning 已启用。  
一个 SysOps 管理员必须将内部数据复制到另一个 S3 bucket 中，位于不同的 AWS 账户中，以进行灾难恢复。  
所有现有的数据都从源 S3 bucket 复制到目标 S3 bucket。  
哪种复制解决方案在操作上最有效率？

question: A company has a high performance computing (HPC) application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application requires minimum latency and maximum network throughput between nodes.  How should a SysOps administrator deploy the EC2 instances to meet these requirements?
A: Use a cluster placement group in a single Availability Zone.
B: Use a cluster placement group across multiple Availability Zones.
C: Use a partition placement group in a single Availability Zone.
D: Use a partition placement group across multiple Availability Zones.
question_zh:
一家公司有一个高性能计算（HPC）应用程序，该应用程序在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。  
该应用程序需要节点之间的最低延迟和最大网络吞吐量。  
SysOps 管理员应如何部署 EC2 实例以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在单一的 Availability Zone 中使用一个 cluster placement group。
B_zh: 使用一个 cluster placement group 跨多个 Availability Zones。
C_zh: 在单一的 Availability Zone 中使用 partition placement group。
D_zh: 使用一个 partition placement group 跨多个 Availability Zones。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司有一个高性能计算（HPC）应用程序，该应用程序在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。  
该应用程序需要节点之间的最低延迟和最大网络吞吐量。  
SysOps 管理员应如何部署 EC2 实例以满足这些要求？

question: A company has a stateless application that is hosted on a fleet of 10 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group. A minimum of 6 instances are needed to meet service requirements.  Which action will maintain uptime for the application MOST cost-effectively?
A: Use a Spot Fleet with an On-Demand capacity of 6 instances.
B: Update the Auto Scaling group with a minimum of 6 On-Demand Instances and a maximum of 10 On-Demand Instances.
C: Update the Auto Scaling group with a minimum of 1 On-Demand Instance and a maximum of 6 On-Demand Instances.
D: Use a Spot Fleet with a target capacity of 6 instances.
question_zh:
一家公司有一个无状态的应用程序，该应用程序托管在一组10个 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 的 Auto Scaling 组中。  
一个最少的6个实例是需要满足服务需求的。  
哪一个操作将以最具成本效益的方式保持应用程序的正常运行时间？
A_zh: 使用一个 Spot Fleet，具有一个 On-Demand 容量为 6 个实例。
B_zh: 用最小值为6的 On-Demand Instances 和最大值为10的 On-Demand Instances 来更新 Auto Scaling group。
C_zh: 用最少 1 个 On-Demand Instance 和最多 6 个 On-Demand Instances 更新 Auto Scaling 组。
D_zh: 使用一个 Spot Fleet，目标容量为 6 实例。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司有一个无状态的应用程序，该应用程序托管在一组10个 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 的 Auto Scaling 组中。  
一个最少的6个实例是需要满足服务需求的。  
哪一个操作将以最具成本效益的方式保持应用程序的正常运行时间？

question: A company has developed a service that is deployed on a fleet of Linux-based Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The service occasionally fails unexpectedly because of an error in the application code. The company's engineering team determines that resolving the underlying cause of the service failure could take several weeks.  A SysOps administrator needs to create a solution to automate recovery if the service crashes on any of the EC2 instances.  Which solutions will meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
A: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances. Configure the CloudWatch agent to monitor the service. Set the CloudWatch action to restart if the service health check fails.
B: Tag the EC2 instances. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to log in to the tagged EC2 instances and restart the service. Schedule the Lambda function to run every 5 minutes.
C: Tag the EC2 instances. Use AWS Systems Manager State Manager to create an association that uses the AWS-RunShellScript document. Configure the association command with a script that checks if the service is running and that starts the service if the service is not running. For targets, specify the EC2 instance tag. Schedule the association to run every 5 minutes.
D: Update the EC2 user data that is specified in the Auto Scaling group's launch template to include a script that runs on a cron schedule every 5 minutes. Configure the script to check if the service is running and to start the service if the service is not running. Redeploy all the EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group with the updated launch template.
E: Update the EC2 user data that is specified in the Auto Scaling group's launch template to ensure that the service runs during startup. Redeploy all the EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group with the updated launch template.
question_zh:
一家公司开发了一个服务，该服务部署在一组基于 Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例上，这些实例位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。  
The service occasionally fails unexpectedly because of an error in the application code.  
该服务偶尔会因为应用程序代码中的错误而意外失败。  
The company's engineering team determines that resolving the underlying cause of the service failure could take several weeks.  
该公司的工程团队确定，解决服务失败的根本原因可能需要数周时间。  
A SysOps administrator needs to create a solution to automate recovery if the service crashes on any of the EC2 instances.  
一名 SysOps 管理员需要创建一个解决方案，以在任何 EC2 实例上的服务崩溃时自动恢复。  
Which solutions will meet this requirement? (Choose two.)  
哪些解决方案将满足此要求？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 在 EC2 实例上安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent。配置 CloudWatch agent 以监控该服务。设置 CloudWatch 操作在服务健康检查失败时重启。
B_zh: 给 EC2 实例打标签。创建一个使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 登录到被标记的 EC2 实例并重启服务的 AWS Lambda 函数。安排 Lambda 函数每 5 分钟运行一次。
C_zh: 给 EC2 实例打标签。使用 AWS Systems Manager State Manager 创建一个关联，该关联使用 AWS-RunShellScript 文档。配置该关联命令，包含一个脚本，用于检查服务是否正在运行，以及在服务未运行时启动该服务。对于目标，指定 EC2 实例标签。安排该关联每 5 分钟运行一次。
D_zh:
更新在 Auto Scaling 组的 launch template 中指定的 EC2 用户数据，以包含一个在 cron 时间表上每 5 分钟运行的脚本。  
配置该脚本以检查服务是否正在运行，并在服务未运行时启动该服务。  
使用更新的 launch template 重新部署 Auto Scaling 组中的所有 EC2 实例。
E_zh:
更新在 Auto Scaling 组的 launch template 中指定的 EC2 用户数据，以确保在启动期间服务运行。  
重新部署 Auto Scaling 组中的所有 EC2 实例，使用更新后的 launch template。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司开发了一个服务，该服务部署在一组基于 Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例上，这些实例位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。  
The service occasionally fails unexpectedly because of an error in the application code.  
该服务偶尔会因为应用程序代码中的错误而意外失败。  
The company's engineering team determines that resolving the underlying cause of the service failure could take several weeks.

A SysOps administrator needs to create a solution to automate recovery if the service crashes on any of the EC2 instances.

Which solutions will meet this requirement? (Choose two.)  
哪些解决方案将满足此要求？（选择两个。）

question: A company's web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The infrastructure must be designed so the application remains available with no performance degradation in the event of an Availability Zone (AZ) failure. To ensure optimal performance, the application must maintain a minimum of 12 instances at all times.  Which solution will meet the requirements with the fewest running instances possible?
A: 2 AZs with 6 instances in each AZ
B: 2 AZs with 12 instances in each AZ
C: 3 AZs with 4 instances in each AZ
D: 3 AZs with 6 instances in each AZ
question_zh:
一家公司 的 网络应用程序 运行 在 Amazon EC2 实例 中 在 一个 AWS 区域 内。  
该 基础设施 必须 被 设计 以 使 该 应用程序 保持 可用，且 在 发生 可用区 (AZ) 失效 时 不会 出现 性能 下降。  
为了 确保 最佳 性能， 该 应用程序 必须 始终 维持 最少 12 个 实例。  
哪种 解决方案 将 满足 要求， 并 使用 最少 的 运行 实例？
A_zh: 每个 AZ 有 6 个实例的 2 个 AZs
B_zh: 每个 AZ 有 12 个实例的 2 个 AZ
C_zh: 每个 AZ 有 4 个实例，共 3 个 AZ
D_zh: 每个 AZ 有 6 个实例的 3 个 AZ
question_zh_zh:
一家公司 的 网络应用程序 运行 在 Amazon EC2 实例 中 在 一个 AWS 区域 内。  
该 基础设施 必须 被 设计 以 使 该 应用程序 保持 可用，且 在 发生 可用区 (AZ) 失效 时 不会 出现 性能 下降。  
为了 确保 最佳 性能， 该 应用程序 必须 始终 维持 最少 12 个 实例。  
哪种 解决方案 将 满足 要求， 并 使用 最少 的 运行 实例？

question: A company needs to monitor the disk utilization of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The EBS volumes are attached to Amazon EC2 Linux instances. A SysOps administrator must set up an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that provides an alert when disk utilization increases to more than 80%.  Which combination of steps must the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
A: Create an IAM role that includes the CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy AWS managed policy. Attach the role to the instances.
B: Create an IAM role that includes the CloudWatchApplicationInsightsReadOnlyAccess AWS managed policy. Attach the role to the instances.
C: Install and start the CloudWatch agent by using AWS Systems Manager or the command line.
D: Install and start the CloudWatch agent by using an IAM role. Attach the CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy AWS managed policy to the role.
E: Configure a CloudWatch alarm to enter ALARM state when the disk_used_percent CloudWatch metric is greater than 80%.
F: Configure a CloudWatch alarm to enter ALARM state when the disk_used CloudWatch metric is greater than 80% or when the disk_free CloudWatch metric is less than 20%.
question_zh:
一家公司需要监控 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷的磁盘利用率。  
The EBS 卷被连接到 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例。  
一名 SysOps 管理员必须设置一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，当磁盘利用率增加到超过 80% 时提供警报。  
哪一组合的步骤 SysOps 管理员必须采取以满足这些要求？（选择三个。）
A_zh: 创建一个 IAM 角色，该角色包含 CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy AWS 管理策略。将该角色附加到实例上。
B_zh: 创建一个 IAM 角色，该角色包括 CloudWatchApplicationInsightsReadOnlyAccess AWS 管理策略。将该角色附加到实例上。
C_zh: 安装并启动 CloudWatch agent 通过使用 AWS Systems Manager 或者 命令行。
D_zh: 使用 IAM 角色安装并启动 CloudWatch agent。将 CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy AWS 管理策略附加到该角色。
E_zh: 配置一个 CloudWatch 警报，当 disk_used_percent CloudWatch 指标大于 80% 时进入 ALARM 状态。
F_zh: 配置一个 CloudWatch 警报，当 disk_used CloudWatch 指标大于 80% 时进入 ALARM 状态，或者当 disk_free CloudWatch 指标小于 20% 时进入 ALARM 状态。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司需要监控 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷的磁盘利用率。  
The EBS 卷被连接到 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例。  
一名 SysOps 管理员必须设置一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，当磁盘利用率增加到超过 80% 时提供警报。  
哪一组合的步骤 SysOps 管理员必须采取以满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

question: An ecommerce company uses an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster for in-memory caching of popular product queries on a shopping website. The cache eviction policy is randomly evicting keys whether or not a TTL is set. A SysOps administrator must improve the cache hit ratio without increasing costs.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Add another node to the ElastiCache cluster.
B: Increase the ElastiCache TTL value.
C: Change the eviction policy to randomly evict keys that have a TTL set.
D: Change the eviction policy to evict the least frequently used keys.

question: A company stores data in Amazon S3 buckets that are provisioned in three separate AWS Regions. question: A company has an Amazon EC2 instance that supports a production system. The EC2 instance is backed by an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. question: A company uses Amazon CloudFront to serve static content to end users. The company's marketing team recently deployed updates to 150 images on the company's website. However, the website is not displaying some of the new images.  A SysOps administrator reviews the CloudFront distribution's cache settings. The default TTL for the distribution is set to 1 week (604,800 seconds).  What should the SysOps administrator do to refresh the cache with the new images in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question: A SysOps administrator wants to share a copy of a production database with a migration account. The production database is hosted on an Amazon RDS DB instance and is encrypted at rest with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that has an alias of production-rds-key.  What must the SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?
A: Take a snapshot of the RDS DB instance in the production account. Amend the KMS key policy of the production-rds-key KMS key to give access to the migration account's root user. Share the snapshot with the migration account.
B: Create an RDS read replica in the migration account. Configure the KMS key policy to replicate the production-rds-key KMS key to the migration account.
C: Take a snapshot of the RDS DB instance in the production account. Share the snapshot with the migration account. In the migration account, create a new KMS key that has an identical alias.
D: Use native database toolsets to export the RDS DB instance to Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket and an S3 bucket policy for cross account access between the production account and the migration account. Use native database toolsets to import the database from Amazon S3 to a new RDS DB instance.

The production database 是托管在一个 Amazon RDS DB instance 上，并且在静态时使用一个具有别名为 production-rds-key 的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥进行加密。

在生产账户中对 RDS DB 实例进行快照。  
修改 production-rds-key KMS 密钥的 KMS 密钥策略，以授予迁移账户的 root 用户访问权限。  
与迁移账户共享快照。

D_zh: 使用本地数据库工具集将 RDS DB 实例导出到 Amazon S3。创建一个 S3 存储桶和一个 S3 存储桶策略，用于生产账户和迁移账户之间的跨账户访问。使用本地数据库工具集将数据库从 Amazon S3 导入到一个新的 RDS DB 实例。

The 生产数据库 是托管在一个 Amazon RDS DB instance 上，并且在静态时使用一个具有别名为 production-rds-key 的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥进行加密。

EBS 卷从快照恢复后，经历的初始性能低于预期。  
该公司的工作负载几乎需要所有的 provisioned IOPS 在附加的 EBS 卷上。  
当 EBS 卷的性能太低时，EC2 实例无法支持工作负载。  
一名 SysOps 管理员必须实施一个解决方案，以确保当 EBS 卷从快照恢复时提供预期的性能。  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company recently deployed an application in production. The production environment currently runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance that hosts the application's web application and a MariaDB database. Company policy states that all IT production environments must be highly available.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Migrate the database from the EC2 instance to an Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB instance. Run the application on EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group that extends across multiple Availability Zones. Place the EC2 instances behind a load balancer.
B: Migrate the database from the EC2 instance to an Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB instance. Use AWS Application Migration Service to convert the application into an AWS Lambda function. Specify the Multi-AZ option for the Lambda function.
C: Copy the database to a different EC2 instance in a different Availability Zone. Use AWS Backup to create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the application EC2 instance and the database EC2 instance. Create an AWS Lambda function that performs health checks every minute. In case of failure, configure the Lambda function to launch a new EC2 instance from the AMIs that AWS Backup created.
D: Migrate the database to a different EC2 instance. Place the application EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group that extends across multiple Availability Zones. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the database EC2 instance. Use the AMI to launch a second database EC2 instance in a different Availability Zone. Put the second database EC2 instance in the stopped state. Use the second database EC2 instance as a standby.
question_zh:
一家公司最近在生产环境中部署了一个应用程序。  
生产环境目前运行在一个单一的 Amazon EC2 实例上，该实例托管了应用程序的 web 应用程序和一个 MariaDB 数据库。  
公司政策规定所有 IT 生产环境必须具有高可用性。  
SysOps 管理员应该采取什么措施以满足这个要求？
A_zh: 将数据库从 EC2 实例迁移到 Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB 实例。 在 EC2 实例上运行应用程序，这些实例位于跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组中。 将 EC2 实例放在负载均衡器后面。
B_zh: 将数据库从 EC2 实例迁移到 Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB 实例。使用 AWS Application Migration Service 将应用程序转换为 AWS Lambda 函数。为 Lambda 函数指定 Multi-AZ 选项。
C_zh: 将数据库复制到不同的 EC2 实例中，在不同的 Availability Zone。使用 AWS Backup 创建应用程序 EC2 实例和数据库 EC2 实例的 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每分钟执行一次健康检查。在失败的情况下，配置 Lambda 函数从 AWS Backup 创建的 AMIs 启动一个新的 EC2 实例。
D_zh: 将数据库迁移到不同的 EC2 实例。将应用程序 EC2 实例放置在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组中。从数据库 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 在不同的 Availability Zone 启动第二个数据库 EC2 实例。将第二个数据库 EC2 实例置于停止状态。将第二个数据库 EC2 实例用作备用。
question_zh_zh:
一家公司最近在生产环境中部署了一个应用程序。  
生产环境目前运行在一个单一的 Amazon EC2 实例上，该实例托管了应用程序的 web 应用程序和一个 MariaDB 数据库。  
公司政策规定所有 IT 生产环境必须具有高可用性。

question: A company is running workloads on premises and on AWS. A SysOps administrator needs to automate tasks across all servers on premises by using AWS services. The SysOps administrator must not install long-term credentials on the on-premises servers.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?
A: Create an IAM role and instance profile that include AWS Systems Manager permissions. Attach the role to the on-premises servers.
B: Create a managed-instance activation in AWS Systems Manager. Install the Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) on the on-premises servers. Register the servers with the activation code and ID from the instance activation.
C: Create an AWS managed IAM policy that includes the appropriate AWS Systems Manager permissions. Download the IAM policy to the on-premises servers.
D: Create an IAM user and an access key. Log on to the on-premises servers and install the AWS CLI. Configure the access key in the AWS credentials file after the AWS CLI is successfully installed.
question_zh: 一家公司正在本地和 AWS 上运行工作负载。一个 SysOps 管理员需要通过使用 AWS 服务自动化所有本地服务器上的任务。这个 SysOps 管理员不得在本地服务器上安装长期凭证。 他们应该做什么以满足这些要求？
A_zh:
创建一个 IAM 角色和实例配置文件，包含 AWS Systems Manager 权限。  
将角色附加到本地服务器。

在 AWS Systems Manager 中创建一个 managed-instance 激活。  
在本地服务器上安装 Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent)。  
使用实例激活中的激活码和 ID 注册这些服务器。
C_zh: 创建一个 AWS 管理的 IAM 策略，包含适当的 AWS Systems Manager 权限。下载 IAM 策略到本地服务器。
D_zh: 创建一个 IAM 用户和一个 access key。登录到本地服务器并安装 AWS CLI。成功安装 AWS CLI 后，在 AWS credentials 文件中配置 access key。

一个 SysOps 管理员需要通过使用 AWS 服务自动化所有本地服务器上的任务。  
这个 SysOps 管理员不得在本地服务器上安装长期凭证。  
他们应该做什么以满足这些要求？

question: A company has 50 AWS accounts and wants to create an identical Amazon VPC in each account. Any changes the company makes to the VPCs in the future must be implemented on every VPC.  What is the MOST operationally efficient method to deploy and update the VPCs in each account?
A: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that defines the VPC. Sign in to the AWS Management Console under each account. Create a stack from the template.
B: Create a shell script that configures the VPC using the AWS CLI. Provide a list of accounts to the shell script from a text file. Create the VPC in every account in the list.
C: Create an AWS Lambda function that configures the VPStore the account information in Amazon DynamoDB. Grant Lambda access to the DynamoDB table. Create the VPC in every account in the list.
D: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that defines the VPC. Create an AWS CloudFormation StackSet based on the template. Deploy the template to all accounts using the stack set.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有50个 AWS 账户，并且想在每个账户中创建一个相同的 Amazon VPC。 任何公司将来对 VPCs 所做的更改都必须在每个 VPC 上实施。 什么是最具操作效率的方法，用于部署和更新每个账户中的 VPCs？
A_zh:
创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，定义 VPC。  
登录到 AWS 管理控制台，在每个账户下。  
从模板创建一个堆栈。
B_zh:
创建一个 shell 脚本，该脚本使用 AWS CLI 配置 VPC。  
向 shell 脚本提供一个文本文件中的账户列表。  
在列表中的每个账户中创建 VPC。
C_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数配置 VPStore 账户信息在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。授予 Lambda 访问权限到 DynamoDB 表。在列表中的每个账户中创建 VPC。
D_zh:
创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，定义 VPC。  
基于该模板创建一个 AWS CloudFormation StackSet。  
使用该 StackSet 将模板部署到所有账户。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司拥有50个 AWS 账户， 并且想在每个账户中创建一个相同的 Amazon VPC。 任何公司将来对 VPCs 所做的更改都必须在每个 VPC 上实施。 什么是最具操作效率的方法，用于部署和更新每个账户中的 VPCs？

question: A company hosts a web application on an Amazon EC2 instance in a production VPC. Client connections to the application are failing. A SysOps administrator inspects the VPC flow logs and finds the following entry:      What is a possible cause of these failed connections?
A: A security group deny rule is blocking traffic on port 443.
B: The EC2 instance is shut down.

D: The VPC has no internet gateway attached.
question_zh: 一家公司在生产 VPC 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个 web 应用程序。 客户端连接到该应用程序失败。 一名 SysOps 管理员检查 VPC 流日志并发现以下条目：      这些连接失败的可能原因是什么？

question: A media company hosts a public news and video portal on AWS. The portal uses an Amazon DynamoDB table with provisioned capacity to maintain an index of video files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. During a recent event, millions of visitors came to the portal for news. This increase in traffic caused read requests to be throttled in the DynamoDB table. Videos could not be displayed in the portal.  The company's operations team manually increased the provisioned capacity on a temporary basis to meet the demand. The company wants the operations team to receive an alert before the table is throttled in the future. The company has created an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and has subscribed the operations team's email address to the SNS topic.  What should the company do next to meet these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that uses the ConsumedReadCapacityUnits metric. Set the alarm threshold to a value that is close to the DynamoDB table's provisioned capacity. Configure the alarm to publish notifications to the SNS topic.
B: Turn on auto scaling on the DynamoDB table. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to publish notifications to the SNS topic during scaling events.
C: Turn on Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the DynamoDB table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric filter to pattern match the THROTTLING_EXCEPTION status code from DynamoDB. Create a CloudWatch alarm for the metric. Select the SNS topic for notifications.
D: Configure the application to store logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric filter to pattern match the THROTTLING_EXCEPTION status code from DynamoDB. Create a CloudWatch alarm for the metric. Select the SNS topic for notifications.
question_zh:
一家媒体公司在 AWS 上托管一个公共新闻和视频门户网站。  
The portal 使用一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表，具有预配置容量，用于维护存储在 Amazon S3 桶中的视频文件的索引。  
During a recent event， 在一次最近的事件中，  
millions of visitors 来到门户网站， 为新闻。  
This increase in traffic 导致 DynamoDB 表中的读取请求被限制。  
Videos 不能在门户网站中显示。  
The company's operations team 手动增加了预配置容量， 临时以满足需求。  
The company 想让运营团队在表被限制之前收到警报。  
The company 已经创建了一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，并已将运营团队的电子邮件地址订阅到 SNS 主题。  
What 应该公司接下来做什么，以满足这些要求？
A_zh:
创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，使用 ConsumedReadCapacityUnits 指标。  
设置警报阈值为接近 DynamoDB 表的预配置容量的值。  
配置警报以向 SNS 主题发布通知。
B_zh: 在 DynamoDB 表上开启自动扩展。配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则以在扩展事件期间向 SNS 主题发布通知。
C_zh: 为 DynamoDB 表开启 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch metric filter 以模式匹配来自 DynamoDB 的 THROTTLING_EXCEPTION 状态码。为该指标创建一个 CloudWatch 警报。选择 SNS 主题以进行通知。
D_zh: 配置应用程序以在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中存储日志。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch metric filter 以匹配 DynamoDB 的 THROTTLING_EXCEPTION 状态码的模式。为该指标创建一个 CloudWatch alarm。选择用于通知的 SNS 主题。

question: A company runs its web application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances that are part of an Auto Scaling group. The company wants the Auto Scaling group to scale out as soon as CPU utilization rises above 50% for the instances.  How should a SysOps administrator configure the Auto Scaling group to meet these requirements?
A: Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on events.
B: Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on a schedule.
C: Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale dynamically based on demand.
D: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use predictive scaling.
question_zh:
一家公司在多个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其网页应用程序，这些实例是 Auto Scaling 组的一部分。  
该公司希望 Auto Scaling 组在实例的 CPU 利用率超过 50% 时立即进行扩展。  
SysOps 管理员应如何配置 Auto Scaling 组以满足这些要求？

B_zh: 配置 自动缩放 组 以 根据 一个 时间表 进行 扩展。
C_zh: 配置 Auto Scaling 组 以 根据 需求 动态 扩展。

SysOps 管理员应如何配置 Auto Scaling 组以满足这些要求？

question: A company's VPC has an existing IPv4 configuration. The IPv4 configuration includes public subnets, private subnets, NAT gateways, default route tables, and ACLs.  The company associates an IPv6 CIDR block with the VPC. The company adds IPv6 allocations to each existing subnet and adds routes to the route tables. The company updates the ACLs to allow all IPv6 traffic.  Public subnets are working as expected, but private subnets are not allowing internet IPv6 connections.  What should a SysOps administrator do to allow outbound-only connectivity for the new IPv6 subnets?
A: Configure an egress-only internet gateway and associate it with the VPC. Create a default route in the route tables that are associated with the private subnets. Configure the default route to point to the egress-only internet gateway.
B: Turn on IPv6 NAT on the NAT gateways. Create a default route in the route tables that are associated with the private subnets. Configure the default route to point to the NAT gateways.
C: Configure a new IPv6-only NAT gateway. Create a default route in the route tables that are associated with the private subnets. Configure the default route to point to the IPv6-only NAT gateway.
D: Create a default route in the route tables that are associated with the private subnets. Configure the default route to point to the existing internet gateway.
question_zh:
一家公司 的 VPC 拥有 一个 现有 的 IPv4 配置。  
The IPv4 configuration 包含 公共 子网、私有 子网、NAT gateways、默认 路由表 和 ACLs。  
The company 将 一个 IPv6 CIDR block 关联 到 VPC。  
The company 添加 IPv6 分配 到 每个 现有 的 子网 并 添加 路由 到 路由表。  
The company 更新 ACLs 以 允许 所有 IPv6 流量。  
公共 子网 按预期 工作，但 私有 子网 不允许 互联网 IPv6 连接。  
什么 应该 一个 SysOps 管理员 做 以 允许 出站 仅 连接性 对于 新的 IPv6 子网？
A_zh: 配置一个 egress-only internet gateway，并将其与 VPC 关联。 在与 private subnets 关联的路由表中创建一个默认路由。 配置默认路由指向 egress-only internet gateway。
B_zh: 在 NAT gateways 上开启 IPv6 NAT。 在与私有子网相关联的路由表中创建一个默认路由。 配置默认路由指向 NAT gateways。
C_zh: 配置一个新的 IPv6-only NAT gateway。 在与私有子网相关联的路由表中创建一个默认路由。 配置默认路由指向 IPv6-only NAT gateway。
D_zh:
在与私有子网相关联的路由表中创建一个默认路由。  
配置默认路由指向现有的 internet gateway。

question: A company runs a worker process on three Amazon EC2 instances. The instances are in an Auto Scaling group that is configured to use a simple scaling policy. The instances process messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.  Random periods of increased messages are causing a decrease in the performance of the worker process. A SysOps administrator must scale the instances to accommodate the increased number of messages.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Use CloudWatch to create a metric math expression to calculate the approximate age of the oldest message in the SQS queue. Create a target tracking scaling policy for the metric math expression to modify the Auto Scaling group.
B: Use CloudWatch to create a metric math expression to calculate the approximate number of messages visible in the SQS queue for each instance. Create a target tracking scaling policy for the metric math expression to modify the Auto Scaling group.
C: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Attach the ALB to the Auto Scaling group. Create a target tracking scaling policy for the ALBRequestCountPerTarget metric to modify the Auto Scaling group.
D: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Attach the ALB to the Auto Scaling group. Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group.
question_zh:
一家公司在三个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 worker 进程。  
这些实例位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中，该组被配置为使用一个 simple scaling policy。  
这些实例处理来自 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列的消息。  
随机的消息增加时期导致 worker 进程的性能下降。  
一名 SysOps 管理员必须扩展实例以适应增加的消息数量。  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh:
使用 CloudWatch 来创建一个 metric math 表达式，以计算 SQS 队列中最旧消息的大致年龄。  
为该 metric math 表达式创建一个目标追踪缩放策略，以修改 Auto Scaling 组。
B_zh: 使用 CloudWatch 来创建一个 metric math 表达式，以计算每个实例中可见的 SQS 消息的大致数量。创建一个目标追踪缩放策略，用于根据该 metric math 表达式来修改 Auto Scaling 组。
C_zh: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 ALB 附加到 Auto Scaling group。创建一个针对 ALBRequestCountPerTarget 指标的目标追踪缩放策略，以修改 Auto Scaling group。
D_zh: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 ALB 附加到 Auto Scaling group。为 Auto Scaling group 创建一个计划的扩展策略。
question_zh_zh:

question: A company has created a NAT gateway in a public subnet in a VPC. The VPC also contains a private subnet that includes Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances use the NAT gateway to access the internet to download patches and updates. The company has configured a VPC flow log for the elastic network interface of the NAT gateway. The company is publishing the output to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.  A SysOps administrator must identify the top five internet destinations that the EC2 instances in the private subnet communicate with for downloads.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A: Use AWS CloudTrail Insights events to identify the top five internet destinations.
B: Use Amazon CloudFront standard logs (access logs) to identify the top five internet destinations.
C: Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to identify the top five internet destinations.
D: Change the flow log to publish logs to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the log files in Amazon S3.
question_zh:

The company has created a NAT gateway in a public subnet in a VPC.  

该 VPC 还包含一个私有子网，其中包括 Amazon EC2 instances。  
The VPC also contains a private subnet that includes Amazon EC2 instances.  

EC2 instances 使用 NAT gateway 访问互联网，以下载补丁和更新。  
The EC2 instances use the NAT gateway to access the internet to download patches and updates.  

该公司为 NAT gateway 的弹性网络接口配置了 VPC flow log。  
The company has configured a VPC flow log for the elastic network interface of the NAT gateway.  

该公司将输出发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。  
The company is publishing the output to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.  

SysOps 管理员必须识别私有子网中的 EC2 instances 通信的前五大互联网目的地，以进行下载。  
A SysOps administrator must identify the top five internet destinations that the EC2 instances in the private subnet communicate with for downloads.  

SysOps 管理员应采取什么措施，以以最具操作效率的方式满足此要求？  
What should the SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A_zh: 使用 AWS CloudTrail Insights 事件 来 识别 出 前 五 个 互联网 目的地 。
B_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudFront 标准日志（访问日志）来识别前五名互联网目的地。
C_zh: 使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 来识别 前五名 的 互联网 目的地 。

question: A company manages its production applications across several AWS accounts. The company hosts the production applications on Amazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux 2. What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?
A: In Account A create an AWS Systems Manager document that updates the /etc/resolv.conf file across all EC2 instances to point to the AWS provided default DNS resolver for the VPC in Account B

C: In Account A use the AWS CLI to create a VPC association authorization. When the association is created.use the AWS CLI in Account B to associate the VPC from Account A with the private hosted zone in Account B.

question: A company uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy its application infrastructure. Recently, a user accidentally changed a property of a database in a CloudFormation template and performed a stack update that caused an interruption to the application. A SysOps administrator must determine how to modify the deployment process to allow the DevOps team to continue to deploy the infrastructure, but prevent against accidental modifications to specific resources.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Set up an AWS Config rule to alert based on changes to any CloudFormation stack. An AWS Lambda function can then describe the stack to determine if any protected resources were modified and cancel the operation.
B: Set up an Amazon EventBridge event with a rule to initiate based on any CloudFormation API call. An AWS Lambda function can then describe the stack to determine if any protected resources were modified and cancel the operation.
C: Launch the CloudFormation templates using a stack policy with an explicit allow for all resources and an explicit deny of the protected resources with an action of Update:*.
D: Attach an IAM policy to the DevOps team role that prevents a CloudFormation stack from updating, with a condition based on the specific Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the protected resources.
question_zh: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 来部署其应用程序基础设施。最近，一个用户意外地更改了 CloudFormation 模板中数据库的一个属性，并执行了导致应用程序中断的堆栈更新。一名 SysOps 管理员必须确定如何修改部署流程，以允许 DevOps 团队继续部署基础设施，但防止对特定资源的意外修改。 哪个解决方案将满足这些要求？
A_zh: 设置一个 AWS Config 规则以基于对任何 CloudFormation stack 的更改发出警报。一个 AWS Lambda function 然后可以描述该 stack 以确定是否有任何受保护的资源被修改并取消操作。
B_zh: 设置一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件，带有一个规则以基于任何 CloudFormation API 调用启动。一个 AWS Lambda 函数然后可以描述这个堆栈，以确定是否有任何受保护的资源被修改，并取消这个操作。
C_zh: 使用堆栈策略启动 CloudFormation templates，具有对所有资源的明确允许和对受保护资源的明确拒绝，操作为 Update:*。
D_zh: 将一个 IAM 政策附加到 DevOps 团队角色，该政策阻止 CloudFormation 堆栈进行更新，具有基于受保护资源的特定 Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) 的条件。

question: A SysOps administrator needs to monitor a process that runs on Linux Amazon EC2 instances. If the process stops, the process must restart automatically. The Amazon CloudWatch agent is already installed on all the EC2 instances.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Add a procstat monitoring configuration to the CloudWatch agent for the process. Create an Amazon EventBridge event rule that initiates an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to restart the process after the process stops.
B: Add a StatsD monitoring configuration to the CloudWatch agent for the process. Create a CloudWatch alarm that initiates an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to restart the process after the process stops.
C: Add a StatsD monitoring configuration to the CloudWatch agent for the process. Create an Amazon EventBridge event rule that initiates an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to restart the process after the process stops.
D: Add a procstat monitoring configuration to the CloudWatch agent for the process. Create a CloudWatch alarm that initiates an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to restart the process after the process stops.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员需要监控在 Linux Amazon EC2 实例上运行的一个进程。  
如果该进程停止，必须自动重新启动该进程。  
Amazon CloudWatch agent 已经安装在所有 EC2 实例上。  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 为该进程添加一个 procstat 监控配置到 CloudWatch agent。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件规则，启动一个 AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook，以在该进程停止后重新启动该进程。
B_zh: 为该进程添加一个 StatsD 监控配置到 CloudWatch agent。创建一个 CloudWatch alarm，该 alarm 会启动一个 AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook，以在该进程停止后重新启动该进程。

question: A company has an application that uses an Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ database. The application becomes unavailable for several minutes every time the database experiences a failover during a planned maintenance event.  What should a SysOps administrator do to reduce the downtime of the application during failover?
A: Create an RDS for MariaDB DB cluster that has multiple writer instances. Configure the application to retry failed queries on another primary node during maintenance events.
B: Configure the RDS maintenance window settings to pool connections while a failover is in process.
C: Configure an Amazon ElastiCache write-through cache for the database. Configure the application to connect to the cache instead of directly to the database.
D: Create an RDS proxy that is associated with the database. Configure the application to connect to the proxy instead of directly to the database.
question_zh:
一家公司有一个应用程序，使用 Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ 数据库。  
该应用程序在计划维护事件期间，每次数据库发生故障转移时，都会变得不可用几分钟。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么，以减少故障转移期间应用程序的停机时间？
A_zh: 为 MariaDB DB 集群创建一个 RDS，具有多个 writer 实例。配置应用程序在维护事件期间在另一个 primary 节点上重试失败的查询。
B_zh: 配置 RDS 维护窗口设置，以在故障转移过程中池连接。
C_zh:
为数据库配置一个 Amazon ElastiCache 写入穿透缓存。  
配置应用程序以连接到缓存而不是直接连接到数据库。
D_zh: 创建一个与数据库相关联的 RDS proxy。配置应用程序以连接到 proxy 而不是直接连接到数据库。

question: A SysOps administrator configures VPC flow logs to publish to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The SysOps administrator reviews the logs in CloudWatch Logs and notices less traffic than expected. B: The CloudWatch IAM role does not have a trust relationship with the VPC flow logs service.

question: A company's SysOps administrator uses AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to connect to an Active Directory. question: A global company wants to allow anyone in the world to upload videos from a mobile phone. The company's mobile app uploads the videos across the public internet to an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region for further processing.Videos that users upload from locations that are distant from us-east-1 have slower upload speeds than videos that users upload from close to us-east-1. In many cases, the slow uploads cause users from the distant locations to cancel their uploads.Which solution will improve the upload speeds for the users from distant locations?
A: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the S3 bucket. Change the mobile app to use the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint for uploads.
B: Create an S3 access point for the S3 bucket in several AWS Regions across the world. Change the mobile app to use the S3 access point endpoint for uploads.
C: Use S3 Select on the S3 bucket. Change the mobile app to use the S3 Select global endpoint for uploads.
D: Create new public Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in several AWS Regions across the world. Specify the S3 bucket as the target of the NLBs. Change the mobile app to use the closest NLB for uploads.
question_zh: 一个全球公司想要允许世界上的任何人用手机上传视频。 该公司的移动应用程序通过公共互联网将视频上传到位于 us-east-1 区域的 Amazon S3 桶，以进行进一步处理。 来自远离 us-east-1 地点的用户上传的视频比来自靠近 us-east-1 的用户上传的视频速度更慢。 在许多情况下，缓慢的上传导致来自远距离地点的用户取消他们的上传。 哪个解决方案将改善来自远距离地点用户的上传速度？
A_zh: 在 S3 bucket 上启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。将移动应用程序更改为使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint 进行上传。
B_zh:
在全球多个 AWS 区域为 S3 bucket 创建一个 S3 access point。  
更改移动应用程序以使用 S3 access point endpoint 进行上传。
C_zh: 在 S3 bucket 上使用 S3 Select。将移动应用程序更改为使用 S3 Select 全局端点进行上传。
D_zh: 在全球多个 AWS Regions 中创建新的公共 Network Load Balancers (NLBs)。 指定 S3 bucket 作为 NLBs 的目标。 改变移动应用程序以使用最近的 NLB 进行上传。

question: A company is using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to manage public SSL/TLS certificates. A SysOps administrator needs to send an email notification when a certificate has less than 14 days until expiration.  Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric to monitor certificate expiration for all ACM certificates. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event source of aws.cloudwatch. Configure the rule to send an event to a target Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if the DaysToExpiry metric is less than 14. Subscribe the appropriate email addresses to the SNS topic.
B: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event source of aws.acm. Configure the rule to evaluate the DaysToExpiry metric for all ACM certificates. Configure the rule to send an event to a target Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if DaysToExpiry is less than 14. Subscribe the appropriate email addresses to the SNS topic.
C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that displays the DaysToExpiry metric for all ACM certificates. If DaysToExpiry is less than 14, send an email message to the appropriate email addresses. Send the email message by running a predefined CLI command to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
D: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event source of aws.acm. Configure the rule to evaluate the DaysToExpiry metric for all ACM certificates. Configure a target SMS identity that uses a predefined email template. Configure the rule to send an event to the target SMS identity if DaysToExpiry is less than 14.
question_zh:
一家公司正在使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 来管理公共 SSL/TLS 证书。  
一名 SysOps 管理员需要在证书距离到期少于 14 天时发送电子邮件通知。  
哪种解决方案将以最少的运营开销满足此要求？
A_zh:
创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 自定义指标，用于监控所有 ACM 证书的到期时间。  
创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，其事件源为 aws.cloudwatch。  
配置该规则，当 DaysToExpiry 指标小于 14 时，将事件发送到目标 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。  
将适当的电子邮件地址订阅到 SNS 主题。
B_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，该规则的事件源为 aws.acm。配置该规则以评估所有 ACM 证书的 DaysToExpiry 指标。配置该规则以在 DaysToExpiry 小于 14 时向目标 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发送事件。将适当的电子邮件地址订阅到 SNS 主题。
C_zh:
创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch dashboard，该 dashboard 显示所有 ACM 证书的 DaysToExpiry 指标。  
如果 DaysToExpiry 小于 14，向适当的电子邮件地址发送电子邮件消息。  
通过运行预定义的 CLI 命令向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发布，发送电子邮件消息。
D_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，该规则具有事件源 aws.acm。配置该规则以评估所有 ACM 证书的 DaysToExpiry 指标。配置一个使用预定义电子邮件模板的目标 SMS 身份。配置该规则以在 DaysToExpiry 小于 14 时向目标 SMS 身份发送事件。
question_zh_zh:

question: A SysOps administrator created an AWS CloudFormation template that provisions an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function is designed to write event details to an Amazon CloudWatch log group. The function has permissions to write events to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. However, the SysOps administrator discovered that the Lambda function is not running.  How should the SysOps administrator resolve the problem?
A: Update the CloudFormation stack to include an AWS::IAM::Role resource with the required IAM permissions for EventBridge to invoke the function. Assign the role to the EventBridge rule.
B: Update the CloudFormation stack to include an AWS::IAM::Role resource with the required IAM permissions for the function. Assign the role as the function execution role.
C: Update the CloudFormation stack with an AWS::Lambda::Permission resource to ensure events.amazonaws.com has permissions to invoke the function.
D: Update the CloudFormation stack with an AWS::Lambda::Permission resource to ensure lambda.amazonaws.com has permissions to invoke the function.
question_zh:
一名 SysOps 管理员创建了一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，该模板配置了一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。  
该 Lambda 函数被设计为将事件详情写入 Amazon CloudWatch 日志组。  
该函数具有向 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 写入事件的权限。  
然而，SysOps 管理员发现 Lambda 函数没有运行。  
SysOps 管理员应该如何解决这个问题？
A_zh: 更新 CloudFormation 堆栈以包括一个 AWS::IAM::Role 资源，具有 EventBridge 调用函数所需的 IAM 权限。将角色分配给 EventBridge 规则。
B_zh: 更新 CloudFormation 堆栈以包括一个 AWS::IAM::Role 资源，具有函数所需的 IAM 权限。将该角色分配为函数执行角色。
C_zh: 使用 AWS::Lambda::Permission 资源更新 CloudFormation 堆栈，以确保 events.amazonaws.com 拥有调用该函数的权限。
D_zh: 使用 AWS::Lambda::Permission 资源更新 CloudFormation 堆栈，以确保 lambda.amazonaws.com 拥有调用该函数的权限。

question: A company has an Amazon EC2 instance that has high CPU utilization. The EC2 instance is a t3.large instance and is running a test web application. The company discovers that the web application would operate better on a compute optimized large instance.  What should a SysOps administrator do to make this change?
A: Migrate the EC2 instance to a compute optimized instance by using AWS VM Import/Export.
B: Enable hibernation on the EC2 instance. Change the instance type to a compute optimized instance. Disable hibernation on the EC2 instance.
C: Stop the EC2 instance. Change the instance type to a compute optimized instance. Start the EC2 instance.
D: Change the instance type to a compute optimized instance while the EC2 instance is running.
question_zh:
一家公司拥有一个 Amazon EC2 实例，该实例具有高 CPU 利用率。  
该 EC2 实例是一个 t3.large 实例，并且正在运行一个测试网页应用程序。  
该公司发现，网页应用程序在一个计算优化的大实例上会运行得更好。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以实现这个更改？
A_zh: 通过使用 AWS VM Import/Export 将 EC2 实例迁移到计算优化实例。
B_zh: 在 EC2 实例上启用休眠。将实例类型更改为计算优化实例。在 EC2 实例上禁用休眠。
C_zh: 停止 EC2 实例。更改实例类型为计算优化实例。启动 EC2 实例。
D_zh: 在 EC2 实例正在运行时，将实例类型更改为计算优化实例。
question_zh_zh:

question: A development team created and deployed a new AWS Lambda function 15 minutes ago. Although the function was invoked many times, Amazon CloudWatch Logs are not showing any log messages.  What is one cause of this?
A: The developers did not enable log messages for this Lambda function.
B: The Lambda function's role does not include permissions to create CloudWatch Logs items.
C: The Lambda function raises an exception before the first log statement has been reached.
D: The Lambda functions creates local log files that have to be shipped to CloudWatch Logs first before becoming visible.
question_zh:
一个开发团队创建并部署了一个新的 AWS Lambda 函数 15 分钟前。  
虽然该函数被调用了多次，  
Amazon CloudWatch Logs 并没有显示任何日志消息。  
这是什么原因之一？
A_zh: 开发者 did not enable log messages for this Lambda function。
B_zh: Lambda 函数的角色 does not 包含 permissions to 创建 CloudWatch Logs 项目。
C_zh: Lambda 函数 在 达到 第一个 日志 语句 之前 引发 了 一个 异常 。
D_zh: Lambda functions 创建 本地 日志 文件 ， 这些 必须 被 传送 到 CloudWatch Logs 首先 ， 之后 才 能 变得 可见 。
question_zh_zh:
一个开发团队创建并部署了一个新的 AWS Lambda 函数 15 分钟前。  
虽然该函数被调用了多次，  
Amazon CloudWatch Logs 并没有显示任何日志消息。  
这是什么原因之一？

question: A company observes that a newly created Amazon CloudWatch alarm is not transitioning out of the INSUFFICIENT_DATA state. The alarm was created to track the mem_used_percent metric from an Amazon EC2 instance that is deployed in a public subnet.  A review of the EC2 instance shows that the unified CloudWatch agent is installed and is running. However, the metric is not available in CloudWatch. A SysOps administrator needs to implement a solution to resolve this problem.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Enable CloudWatch detailed monitoring for the EC2 instance
B: Create an IAM instance profile that contains CloudWatch permissions. Add the instance profile to the EC2 instance
C: Migrate the EC2 instance into a private subnet
D: Create an IAM user that has an access key ID and a secret access key. Update the unified CloudWatch agent configuration file to use those credentials
question_zh:
一家公司观察到一个新创建的 Amazon CloudWatch alarm 没有从 INSUFFICIENT_DATA 状态过渡出来。  
该 alarm 被创建用来跟踪来自部署在公共子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例的 mem_used_percent metric。  
对 EC2 实例的审查显示，已安装并运行了统一的 CloudWatch agent。  
然而，metric 在 CloudWatch 中不可用。  
一名 SysOps administrator 需要实施一个解决方案以解决这个问题。  
哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 启用 CloudWatch 详细监控 对于 EC2 实例
B_zh: 创建 一个 IAM 实例配置文件 ， 其中 包含 CloudWatch 权限 。 添加 该 实例配置文件 到 EC2 实例
C_zh: 将 EC2 实例迁移到私有子网
D_zh: 创建 一个 IAM 用户 那个 有 一个 access key ID 和 一个 secret access key 。 更新 那个 统一 的 CloudWatch agent 配置文件 以 使用 那些 凭证
question_zh_zh:
一家公司观察到一个新创建的 Amazon CloudWatch alarm 没有从 INSUFFICIENT_DATA 状态过渡出来。

哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company is uploading important files as objects to Amazon S3. The company needs to be informed if an object is corrupted during the upload.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Pass the Content-Disposition value as a request body during the object upload
B: Pass the Content-MD5 value as a request header during the object upload
C: Pass x-amz-object-lock-mode as a request header during the object upload
D: Pass x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-algorithm as a request body during the object upload
question_zh:
一家公司正在将重要文件作为对象上传到 Amazon S3。  
该公司需要在对象在上传过程中被损坏时得到通知。  
SysOps 管理员应该做什么以满足这个要求？
A_zh: 在对象上传期间，将 Content-Disposition 值作为请求体传递
B_zh: 在对象上传期间，将 Content-MD5 值作为请求头传递
C_zh: 在对象上传期间，将 x-amz-object-lock-mode 作为请求头传递
D_zh: 在对象上传期间，将 x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-algorithm 作为请求正文传递
question_zh_zh:
一家公司正在将重要文件作为对象上传到 Amazon S3。  
The company is uploading important files as objects to Amazon S3。  
该公司需要在对象在上传过程中被损坏时得到通知。
